jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Reconstruction Project Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SERVPRO of Beverly Hills** is **NOW HIRING** a **Reconstruction Project Administration Coordinator -** ***APPLY TODAY!***

**Location:** Beverly Hills, CA (In-Office)

**Job Type:** Full-Time (Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; occasional extended hours/weekends as needed)

**Pay Rate:** $28.85 / hour

**Drive Projects Forward & Build Your Career in Operations!**

When disaster impacts a property, execution, speed, and accuracy make all the difference. At **SERVPRO of Beverly Hills**, we are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Reconstruction Project Administration Coordinator** to take full ownership of our job files and drive work seamlessly from start to finish.

In this vital role, you will act as the central hub connecting Production, Estimating, Insurance/TPAs, and Accounting. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess an ownership mindset, and excel at managing details while getting projects billed and paid, this is the perfect career step for you!

**Why Join SERVPRO of Beverly Hills?**

* **Competitive Pay:** $28.85/hour with reliable, weekly compensation.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance.
* **Paid Time Off:** PTO and Paid Sick Leave to support work-life balance.
* **Impact & Ownership:** Serve as the engine of our reconstruction operations, driving projects directly into revenue.
* **Growth & Support:** Work alongside experienced leadership in a collaborative environment that values accountability, organization, and professional development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Job File Ownership:** Track job statuses across internal systems to proactively resolve gaps and prevent project delays.
* **Estimate & Insurance Coordination:** Submit estimates to insurance carriers and TPA programs, track revisions/supplements, and follow up regularly through approval.
* **Client & Stakeholder Communication:** Communicate clearly with property owners regarding scopes, schedules, delays, and required documentation.
* **Documentation & Compliance:** Ensure all file photos, moisture logs, authorizations (COS, ATP), timestamps, and job notes comply with SERVPRO, TPA, carrier, and DASH program standards.
* **Billing Preparation & Invoice Submission:** Audit job files for completion, verify approved scopes, and submit complete invoice packages for program and non-program (self-pay) jobs.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Technical Skills:** Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, Teams, Outlook, and modern workplace technology platforms.
* **Key Strengths:** Exceptional organizational habits, high attention to detail, time management, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* **Mindset:** Strong ownership mentality, accountability, and the ability to prioritize multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.
* **Schedule & Flexibility:** Ability to work full-time (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday–Friday), with flexibility for occasional extended hours or weekend work when emergency job volumes require.
* **Preferred Experience:** Prior experience in restoration, construction, or insurance claims, along with familiarity with software such as WorkCenter, DASH, Xactimate, or TPA portals (Contractor Connection, XactAnalysis, State Farm).

**How to Apply**

If you are an organized, proactive professional ready to take ownership of your work and grow with an industry leader, submit your resume today to get started!

*SERVPRO of Beverly Hills is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

*All employees of a SERVPRO® Franchise are hired by, employed by, and under the sole supervision and control of an independently owned and operated SERVPRO® Franchise. SERVPRO® Franchise employees are not employed by, jointly employed by, agents of, or under the supervision or control of Servpro Franchisor, LLC, in any manner whatsoever.*

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

KPFF Consulting Engineers provides structural and civil engineering services to architects, government agencies, developers, and contractors for projects with a wide range of functions. Established in 1960, KPFF has offices in Austin, Birmingham, Boise, Chicago, Des Moines, Eugene, Irvine, Lacey, Long Beach, Los Angeles, Louisville, Nashville, Newport Beach, New York City, Portland, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Spokane, St. Louis, Tacoma, and Washington, DC..

KPFF's civil engineering staff accomplishes projects for site development, parks, and recreation facilities and the improvements to existing city streets, urban arterials, and highways. Scope of services may include site planning, environmental analysis, storm drainage studies, wetlands enhancement, permit coordination, and design of site grading, drainage, storm detention, utilities, access roads, parking facilities, and public street improvements.

In addition to typical site development engineering, our civil group serves as a prime consultant to government clients for management and design of transportation, waterfront, site improvements, and major utility projects.

Our engineers work in dynamic teams with open communication and strong support from senior-level mentors. These teams work directly with our clients on some of the most challenging projects in the region. We promote decision-making at the level closest to the issue in order to most efficiently and effectively serve our clients, and to promote professional growth for our staff.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Coordinator to join our team in downtown Los Angeles.

A Project Coordinator must be quality conscious with the ability to balance multiple assignments in a fast-paced, team environment. A team-oriented approach and the ability to collaborate with technical professionals is essential. The ability to listen and understand customer expectations, take direction from peers, and communicate effectively and proactively is required.

Responsibilities:

* Process contracts and amendments.
* Prepare subconsultant agreement letters.
* Answer general project questions for clients and subconsultants.
* Resolve invoicing and payment questions from subconsultants.
* Review invoice drafts each month and work with accounting to send invoices and any additional reports to the client.
* Maintain project files.
* Prepare records, reports, and correspondence using standards and templates.
* Assists Project Manager with workload planning and coordination.
* Develop and maintain project schedules.
* Work with Administrative team to prepare and distribute documents.
* Coordinate delivery of plans and proposals.
* Perform construction administration tasks: Track Requests for Information (RFI’s) and submittals, request review by technical staff, transmit responses, and file tracking logs.
* Work with Administrative team on Archiving process.
* Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with KPFF staff, clients, consultants, contractors, and other personnel associated with KPFF.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong attention to detail.
* Exceptional verbal, written and presentation skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines with dependability and consistency.
* Working knowledge of basic office equipment.
* Ability to adapt quickly, identify, and solve problems.
* Understand methods and techniques of data collection, research, report preparation, and financial analysis.
* Strong organizational, logistical, and time-management skills with ability to handle multiple concurrent tasks and meet deadlines.

  
**Qualifications**

Position Requirements:

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* High level of proficiency required in Excel, Word, and Microsoft Project.
* Experience in the architectural/engineering or construction industry preferred.
* Experience applying General Accounting principles.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why KPFF?**

**Mentorship & Development:** Through KPFF’s *Forefront Education Program*, you’ll receive unparalleled mentorship from seasoned professionals, empowering you to excel in your career from day one. Thrive in a setting that values your development and independence, where your ideas are welcomed, and your contributions make a real impact.

**Relationship Building:** At our core, we focus on forging meaningful connections. By prioritizing trust and stability, we create lasting relationships with our partners and clients that stand the test of time.

**Supportive Environment:** We cultivate growth in all aspects of your life in a supportive environment that values your well-being. From promoting a healthy lifestyle to organizing social activities, we strive to create a balanced and fulfilling workplace.

**Compensation**

The base salary for this role is competitive and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, education, and skills. The expected base salary for a qualified candidate is **$65,000 - $80,000.** Additionally, we offer performance-based bonuses to recognize and reward outstanding contributions in each Reporting Center. During the interview process, we'll provide detailed information and address any questions you may have about the overall compensation package and benefits.

KPFF Consulting Engineers participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.description:
**Job Title(s):** Part-Time Program Specialist I, II, III

**Reports to:** Operations Department

**Wages:** $19.00 - $26.00 Hourly \*Actual wages are based upon level of education and or experience\*

**Position Summary:**

The Part-Time **Program Specialist I, II, III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one-on-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of support, progress, and services.

Some key responsibilities of this role are providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines; promoting independent living skills; and supporting with Community Integration and Employment Goals. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to fit each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Facilitate virtual check-ins and video sessions with individuals and families to assess progress, review personal goals, and determine support needs.**

You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma-informed, person-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

* **Provide direct individualized educational support to individuals.**

You will provide one-on-one educational support based on each individual's needs, abilities, learning style, and goals, including school routines, classroom participation, assignments, organization, and time management. Support should encourage participation while promoting independence.

* **Support individuals in developing academic and educational skills.**

You will help individuals develop communication, organization, task completion, problem-solving, self-advocacy, study habits, and other skills that support educational success. Instruction will be adapted to each individual's learning style and support needs.

* **Plan and lead individualized coaching sessions focused on employment readiness, independent living, educational success, and personal development.**

You will provide structured, goal-driven coaching based on each individual's strengths, needs, and goals, including areas such as interview preparation, budgeting, communication, organization, educational participation, and daily living. Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

* **Utilize individualized teaching and instructional techniques to support learning and skill development.**

You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step-by-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

* **Support individuals with educational routines, schedules, and responsibilities.**

You will assist individuals with following educational schedules, transitioning between activities, preparing materials, completing assignments, managing time, and maintaining routines that promote greater independence.

* **Conduct virtual work readiness training, including mock interviews, resume workshops, and job search support.**

You will provide training in resume development, interview preparation, digital literacy, and online job searches, with opportunities for one-on-one coaching and support as needed.

* **Provide individualized instruction and skill training across educational, community, employment, and daily living environments.**

You will help individuals develop and apply skills across educational, community, employment, and daily living settings, including hygiene, cooking, laundry, mobility, community navigation, social skills, and employment-related skills.

* **Design and implement engaging remote community-based activities, and support transitions to in-person programming when needed.**

You will create and facilitate accessible virtual activities that encourage social connection, engagement, and community participation, while providing continuity and support when individuals transition to in-person programming.

* **Collaborate with on-site staff, job coaches, and program coordinators to coordinate seamless service delivery.**

You will communicate updates, share documentation, and collaborate with team members to maintain consistency in support plans and services. Bilingual communication may also help strengthen coordination with Spanish-speaking families.

* **Set measurable weekly and monthly objectives to help individuals build communication, life, educational, and employment skills.**

You will help individuals establish achievable goals related to communication, daily living, education, employment, and personal development. Progress will be monitored and goals adjusted as needed, with support provided in the individual's preferred language when appropriate.

* **Track and document individual progress, support needs, and goals using internal agency systems.**

You will maintain accurate, timely, objective, and confidential records of individual progress, support needs, goals, observations, and follow-up requirements using agency systems.

* **Submit accurate monthly progress notes, service logs, and activity calendars in compliance with agency deadlines.**

You will complete and submit timely documentation reflecting sessions, training, coaching, educational support, and other services provided while following agency formats and deadlines.

* **Create accessible learning materials such as visual aids, slides, and training tools using Canva, Google Slides, or Pow

jobs.title: Membership Engagement & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position: **Membership Engagement** **& Events Coordinator**

Dept: Administration [Membership]

Type: Full-Time, Exempt

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Under the direction of the Program Director and Senior Clergy, this full-time position will play a pivotal role in meeting the needs of our Temple members. Through both relationship building efforts and the planning and implementation of diverse programs designed to meet the needs of identified micro-communities, this position will be on the front lines of membership recruitment, membership retention and relationship building.

S/he will have an integral role in creating processes that support and build an ecosystem at Sinai Temple where both current members and prospective members experience Sinai as their second home- a place where they are known by name, feel connected to a micro-community of like minded people, and feel supported through life’s peaks and valleys.

The individual in this position will exercise independent judgement and discretion on important items, including: the planning and implementation of opportunities for social, professional and spiritual growth for multiple groups at Sinai Temple, including, but not limited to: individuals and couples in their 20s and 30s; “Empty Nesters”- individuals with young adult children, growing families, and others. In this role, this individual will support the planning and execution of diverse Sinai Temple events. S/he will resourcefully problem-solve, be a welcoming and warm presence for our constituents and ensure a positive and meaningful experience for program participants.

  

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

**MEMBERSHIP ENGAGEMENT- RELATIONSHIP BUILDING**

* Collaborate and brainstorm with Senior Clergy on strategic approaches related to membership recruitment, engagement, and retention.
* Develop and implement an effective **onboarding program**, welcoming new members into the Sinai Temple community
  + Conduct new member intake conversation and guide new members through the enrollment process
  + Input and maintain accurate new member dues information in Excel
  + Meaningful data collection on new members- identify what they are looking for from a synagogue and use that information to proactively connect them with the appropriate interest groups within our community
  + Coordinate a New Member Mentor Program, thoughtfully pairing new members with established members to help them navigate synagogue life
  + Connect new members to clergy and staff in an intentional and thoughtful manner
  + Develop intentional efforts for Year #2 members

* Create and implement new member orientation experiences (building tour, clergy/staff meet and greet, overview of opportunities, welcome bags, etc)
* Develop **micro communities** and relational networks
  + Launch 2-4 **professional affinity groups** (e.g., medical, legal/finance, entertainment/real estate, education/ nonprofit, etc.).
  + Intentionally facilitate connections between members to foster personal g

* Share relevant information about members (pastoral, fundraising etc) to Executive Director and clergy.
* Attend and support Membership Committee meetings.

  

**MEMBERSHIP ENGAGEMENT THROUGH PROGRAMMING**

In collaboration with the Program Director, conceptualize, plan, implement and evaluate demographic specific programs to meet diverse needs and wants, supporting the relationship building.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the ATID community, with a strong understanding of and connection to the experiences, interests, and needs of members in their 20s and 30s.
* Coordinate run monthly Ted(z”l)& Hedy(z”l) Orden and Family **Friday Night Live****s**

* Create, update, send weekly newsletter to the ATID community

* Assist with execution of community wide events and programs (e.g., High Holy Days, Purim Carnival, Community Seder, etc.)
* Plan and coordinate Micro-Community events throughout the year, each designed to engage specific member demographics or life stages (i.e. young professionals, empty nesters, etc.)

* Work collaboratively with Temple Communications Manager to effectively market all engagement opportunities for members, including eblasts, social media promos and more
* Act as Staff Point at Sinai Temple events ensuring that programming runs smoothly from start to finish
* Converse comfortably with the public in an outgoing, friendly, and professional manner

  

**ADDITIONAL DUTIES**

* Be available to Executive Director as needed for emergent projects and assignments.
* Attend High Holy Day services to assist with smooth implementation of HHD operation.
* Attend and monitor at Shabbat services once a month - to be pre-arranged

* Attend weekly staff meetings

  

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

* Creative thinker
* Self-motivated, takes pride in his/her work
* Ability to complete tasks with minimal “hand-holding”

**Overview**

At Overhill Dental, every smile has a story. We provide comprehensive and cosmetic dental care centered on health, confidence, and an exceptional patient experience. We are looking for a dependable, resourceful individual who enjoys connecting with people and helping them move confidently through their care.

You will coordinate the patient journey from the first inquiry through treatment scheduling, payment, and follow-up. This role combines patient service, treatment coordination, and front office administration. You will work closely with the dentist and clinical team to keep patients informed, schedules productive, and administrative details accurate.

**Duties:**

**Treatment coordination and follow through**

* Review dentist-approved treatment plans with patients, explaining proposed appointments, fees, estimated insurance benefits (if applicable), and expected patient responsibility in understandable terms.
* Reinforce information provided by the clinical team and refer questions about diagnosis, necessity, risks, alternatives, or prognosis to the treating clinician.
* Discuss financial concerns respectfully, explain approved payment and financing options, and assist with applications without promising approval.
* Schedule recommended care in the sequence and appointment lengths directed by the clinical team; coordinate referrals when needed.
* Maintain an organized follow-up list for unscheduled treatment, pending financial arrangements, and patients who need additional information; document contacts and outcomes.
* Support informed patient decisions without pressure, guarantees of clinical results, or representations that insurance estimates are guaranteed.

**Patient experience and communication**

* Welcome patients warmly, manage check-in and checkout, and create a professional, organized front office.
* Respond promptly to calls, texts, emails, and new patient inquiries; document conversations and follow through on next steps.
* Coordinate onboarding, digital forms, confirmations, and appointment preparation; identify missing information before visits.
* Listen to patient concerns, resolve routine service issues, and escalate clinical questions, complaints, or exceptions appropriately.

**Scheduling and financial administration**

* Manage the dentist and hygiene schedules using approved appointment templates, treatment priorities, and provider availability.
* Monitor cancellations, openings, and waitlists; offer appropriate appointments and coordinate changes with the clinical team.
* Coordinate recall and reactivation outreach to help established patients maintain ongoing care.
* Prepare written financial estimates and agreements, communicate payment expectations before appointments, and collect required payment before treatment in accordance with practice policy.
* Process payments accurately, issue receipts, post transactions, and reconcile daily collections with practice records.
* Review patient balances, follow up on amounts due, and escalate disputed charges, refunds, discounts, or adjustments for authorization.
* Verify insurance eligibility and available benefits before visits; obtain necessary information and clearly distinguish estimates from confirmed payments.
* Support claim preparation, submission, tracking, and follow-up as assigned; coordinate unresolved insurance issues with the designated billing lead or practice leadership.

**Office systems and team coordination**

* Maintain accurate patient demographics, communication notes, financial records, and administrative documentation in the practice management system.
* Learn and use Practice Management Software and other approved tools for scheduling, communication, insurance workflows, and patient payments.
* Participate in daily team huddles, flag scheduling or financial concerns, and provide clear handoffs between the front office and clinical team.
* Protect confidential patient and financial information and follow practice privacy, security, and HIPAA procedures.
* Monitor assigned office supplies and reorder within approved budgets and purchasing authority.
* Identify recurring workflow problems, recommend practical improvements, and maintain checklists that make daily work more reliable.
* Support related front office duties as practice needs evolve, with priorities set by leadership.

**Who will succeed here**

You are warm with patients and precise with details. You can discuss money calmly, manage competing priorities, and close the loop on commitments. You ask thoughtful questions, learn unfamiliar systems, and take initiative while recognizing when a decision requires clinical or leadership approval.

* Exceptional patient service and professional verbal and written communication.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, accurate data entry, and comfort working with numbers.
* Resourcefulness, sound judgment, problem-solving, and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to discuss treatment costs and payment expectations with empathy and confidence.
* Dependability, accountability, coachability, and a collaborative approach.
* Comfort with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and learning new software.

**Our culture and how to apply**

We value kindness, professionalism, curiosity, and accountability. We want someone who takes pride in helping patients and enjoys contributing to a growing practice. In return, we offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to learn, and a meaningful role in how our practice serves its community.

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction describing your relevant experience, your comfort discussing treatment costs and payments, and why this role interests you.

* 401(k) matching

**The Opportunity**

**Position Title:** Outreach Coordinator

**Department:** Development

**Location:** Anaheim, CA

**Reports To:** Outreach Manager

**Classification:** Non-Exempt

**Status:** Part-Time, up to 30 hours per week

**Compensation:** $28.16–$35.20/hourly commensurate with skills and experience

**Join the team behind the mission**

Every day, people across California turn to the Council on American-Islamic Relations, California (CAIR-CA) when they face discrimination, threats to their civil rights, or challenges to their freedom to practice their faith. As the largest Muslim civil rights and advocacy organization in California, we protect constitutional rights, advance justice, and empower communities through legal advocacy, public policy, civic engagement, and education.

Since 1994, that work has been made possible by a dedicated team committed to serving individuals, families, and communities across California. Behind every case, campaign, and initiative are people working together to create meaningful change.

Whether you serve clients directly or support our mission behind the scenes, your work helps build a more just, inclusive, and equitable California.

**Why CAIR-CA**

**Meaningful Work:** Your work directly contributes to protecting civil rights, advancing justice, and strengthening communities throughout California.

**Collaborative Culture:** Team members value respect, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Professional Growth:** We support your development through mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and impact.

**Purpose-Driven Environment:** Colleagues create meaningful change and serve communities with dedication and integrity.

**Statewide Impact:** No matter your role, your contributions advance CAIR-CA's mission and create lasting impact throughout California.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

As the Outreach Coordinator, you will strengthen relationships between CAIR and the American Muslim community throughout the Greater Los Angeles area by building meaningful partnerships, expanding awareness of our programs and services, and connecting individuals with resources that support and empower their communities.

Through outreach events, educational programs, volunteer engagement, and collaboration with local mosques, Muslim Student Associations (MSAs), nonprofit organizations, community leaders, and other partners, you will help advance CAIR's mission and increase our impact across the region.

**In this role, you will do the following:**

* Work with management to develop and implement outreach strategies that strengthen CAIR's presence and accessibility throughout the Greater Los Angeles area.
* Build and maintain relationships with local mosques, Islamic centers, Muslim Student Associations (MSAs), youth groups, community leaders, nonprofit organizations, and other community partners.
* Coordinate, participate, and represent CAIR in community outreach and educational activities, including Friday prayer outreach, Ramadan initiatives, Know Your Rights presentations, resource fairs, educational workshops, community meetings, conferences and other community events.
* Recruit, engage, and support volunteers through outreach efforts, community events, and ongoing relationship building.
* Assist in planning and promoting community engagement initiatives, fundraising campaigns, Ramadan outreach, annual fundraising events, and other organizational programs.
* Create and distribute educational and outreach materials in collaboration with internal teams and maintain an organized inventory of outreach resources.
* Maintain accurate records of outreach activities, community partnerships, volunteer engagement, and event participation.
* Collaborate with internal departments to promote CAIR's civil rights services, legal services, civic engagement initiatives, educational programming, advocacy campaigns, and community resources.
* Identify opportunities to expand community partnerships and increase awareness of CAIR's programs throughout the Greater Los Angeles area.
* Attend relevant internal and external meetings, trainings, and community events as needed.

*Other duties as assigned, dependent on organizational needs and employee skills. All CAIR staff are required to assist in general duties such as answering phones, weekly outreach, and other office tasks.*

**What You Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or at least two years of relevant professional experience in a related field.
* At least two years of experience working with Muslim communities.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

OMI Specialty Products is a leading aerospace supplier with a proud history dating back to 1968. We provide aerospace parts, hardware, chemicals, and raw materials to OEMs, MROs, airlines, and their suppliers in both civil and defense applications, serving customers around the world. Our commitment to excellence, responsiveness, and integrity has made us a trusted partner across the industry.

**The Role**

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Account Manager to join our inside sales team. You will own a book of customer accounts — turning RFQs into competitive quotes, sourcing parts from suppliers, and making sure every order ships complete and on time. This is a fast-paced, high-volume role for someone who likes solving problems, works well with a team, and wants to grow a career in aerospace sales.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Quote fast and accurately:** Respond to customer RFQs with competitive, accurate quotes in our ERP system, typically within the same business day.
* **Source parts:** Find pricing and availability using our sales history, ILS, and our supplier network; negotiate price and lead time with vendors.
* **Manage your accounts:** Build relationships with buyers at your assigned customers, follow up on open quotes, and grow your accounts by cross-selling OMI’s parts, hardware, chemicals, and raw materials.
* **Own the order:** Work with procurement, expediting, quality, and shipping to keep orders on track; resolve issues such as rejections, shortages, lead-time changes, and returns.
* **Get the paperwork right:** Ensure orders meet customer and aerospace quality requirements, including traceability, certifications, and documentation.
* **Stay compliant:** Follow OMI’s export-compliance procedures (ITAR/EAR), including customer and end-use screening.
* **Keep data clean:** Maintain accurate customer, quote, and order records in the ERP.
* **Step up:** Support the team and lead day-to-day activity in the sales manager’s absence.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 3-5 years of sales, account management, or customer service experience in the aerospace distribution industry, or a bachelor’s degree in business or a related field with a strong interest in aerospace sales.
* Experience in aerospace distribution, OEMs, MRO, and/or brokering is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with ILS, PartsBase, Aeroxchange or Quantum Control is a plus.
* Comfortable with margins, markups, and percentages; strong Microsoft Excel and Outlook skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; professional and responsive with customers and vendors.
* Organized and detail-oriented, able to manage many open quotes and orders at once.
* A team player who works well across sales, purchasing, quality, and shipping.
* Additional languages are a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary plus performance bonus
* Career growth in a growing, global company
* A high-performing, supportive team
* On-site employee gym and recreation area
* On-site micro market

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (including family coverage)
* Life insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off, paid sick leave, and paid company holidays

**Compensation**

Competitive base salary and benefits, plus performance bonus. Actual pay depends on experience and qualifications.

**Location**

Fullerton, California.

**Additional Information**

This position requires access to technology and technical data subject to U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals) or be eligible to obtain any required U.S. government authorization.

OMI Specialty Products is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. We provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Vast is developing next-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. jobs.title: Associate Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

We're looking for a chronically online Associate Social Media Manager who moves at the speed of social. You know what stops the scroll, what feels native vs. forced, and how to turn an idea into something people actually want to watch and share. If you live in the comment sections, follow reality TV drama like a sport, know what’s trending before it hits the mainstream, and get Virgo-level obsessed about data and content calendars, this is the role for you.

You'll support the Social Content Lead and Senior Social Director in managing the content calendar, creating and optimizing content across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, and owning day-to-day community management from the caption to the comment section.

### **Where You'll Work:**

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week in Los Angeles, CA.

  

### **In This Role, You Will:**

***Support and create strategic content execution and social media campaigns***

* Build and manage day-to-day posting calendars
* Create and optimize social-first content for TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms, including supporting with hands-on graphic design and video editing
* Support social campaign development, including research, briefs, and creative strategy
* Move a post from a raw idea to a published asset — including copywriting, asset creation, approvals, and scheduling
* Write engaging captions, Threads, and tweets
* Schedule, tag, and publish posts for content optimization and reporting

***Own community management***

* Reply to comments and direct messages in the brand's voice
* Monitor brand mentions and sentiment across platforms
* Foster fan relationships and surface earned moments
* Source and manage UGC opportunities across platforms
* Escalate sensitive comments, DMs, or sentiment shifts according to team guidelines
* Surface insights from comments, DMs, and cultural shifts
* Help the broader team understand what's actually resonating (or not)

***Track performance for insights-to-action***

* Pull analytics reports across platforms
* Track engagement, reach, and follower growth
* Apply insights to action — feed learnings back into the content daily

***Trend watching***

* Spot internet culture shifts, viral trends and formats, emerging platforms, and competitor moves
* Surface potential risks, controversies, and emerging narratives taking place on internet communities
* Identify up-and-coming creators and talent for owned social campaigns

### **Skills Required:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on social media marketing experience
* Strong understanding of scheduling and listening software (i.e. Dash Social)
* Ability to concept, shoot, design, edit, and publish thumb-stopping social content; video editing and graphic design experience required.
* Comfortable behind or in-front-of the camera
* Experience creating and executing content calendars
* Deep understanding of social-first storytelling, internet culture, platform trends, and short-form video content. Fluent in TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including formats, trends, and what actually performs with Gen Z women
* Internet, culture, and Gen-Z fluent - knows the biggest trends, tv shows, creators, and cultural moments before they go viral
* Strong writer with a sense of humor. Experience writing engaging captions and comments; fluent in Gen Z, internet, entertainment, and pop culture across the different social platforms
* Proficient in graphic design and video editing software like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop)
* Strong communication, organizational, and creative judgment skills, with a high-ownership, hands-on approach
* Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Design, PR, and Paid Media teams
* Comfort with trackers and spreadsheets (Google Sheets) for managing multiple campaigns in parallel
* Able to prioritize and move fast when timelines shift or something breaks last-minute
* Flexibility for occasional evenings, weekends, and local travel for events and shoots

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Social Media & Content Manager

**Full-Time | 40 Hours Per Week | Initial 3-Month Contract | Travel Required | Remuneration Negotiable Based on Experience**

We’re looking for a **creative, highly social-media-literate Social Media & Content Manager** to manage social media and content across two music artist projects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands what makes great social content and knows how to turn music, personality, performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and everyday activity into content people genuinely want to watch and engage with.

You’ll work closely with the artists and management while taking ownership of the day-to-day social media and content operation across both projects — from coming up with ideas and capturing content through to editing, publishing, community management, and analyzing performance.

This role will also involve **travel with the artists when required** to capture content around performances, shoots, promotional opportunities, and other key moments.

What You’ll Be Doing

* Manage the day-to-day social media presence across two artist projects.
* Develop and execute distinct social media and content strategies for each artist.
* Create and manage content calendars across TikTok, Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant platforms.
* Generate original content concepts and recurring social formats.
* Film and capture social-first content with the artists.
* Edit engaging short-form video content.
* Understand and implement strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, and retention techniques.
* Write captions and maintain a consistent and recognizable tone of voice for each project.
* Post, schedule, and optimize content across platforms.
* Identify relevant trends, memes, sounds, formats, and cultural moments — and understand which ones actually make sense for each artist.
* Turn studio sessions, rehearsals, performances, shoots, travel, releases, and everyday moments into compelling social content.
* Plan and execute social content around singles, music videos, performances, announcements, and other key moments.
* Work with longer-form and podcast content, identifying strong moments and repurposing them into effective short-form content.
* Travel with the artists when required to capture and create content around performances, shoots, promotional activity, and other key moments.
* Manage audience engagement and help build active online communities around both projects.
* Identify collaboration and cross-posting opportunities with creators, guests, and other relevant accounts.
* Monitor social performance across platforms.
* Understand metrics including watch time, retention, reach, shares, saves, engagement, and follower growth.
* Use analytics to determine what is working, what isn't, and what should be tested next.
* Test different concepts, hooks, edits, formats, and posting approaches to continually improve performance.
* Organize content, assets, deadlines, approvals, and publishing schedules across both projects.
* Communicate regularly with the artists and management around upcoming content needs, ideas, priorities, and results.
* Take ownership of the social media workflow while collaborating closely with the wider team.

What We’re Looking For

You should have a **strong instinct for social media, content, and internet culture** and genuinely enjoy figuring out why certain content works.

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has a deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
* Has strong short-form filming and editing skills.
* Understands hooks, pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.
* Has a strong creative eye and good visual instincts.
* Can consistently generate content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to make.
* Understands music, entertainment, and artist culture.
* Can recognize interesting, funny, emotional, or engaging moments that others might overlook.
* Is comfortable filming and working directly with artists.
* Understands the difference between jumping on trends and creating content that actually fits someone's identity.
* Can take a piece of long-form or podcast content and identify the moments most likely to work on social.
* Can balance creative instincts with analytics and performance data.
* Is organized and capable of managing multiple platforms and content streams simultaneously.
* Can work independently and take ownership while communicating effectively with artists and management.
* Can move quickly when an unexpected content opportunity arises.
* Is comfortable with **domestic and potentially international travel** as required.
* Is willing to experiment, learn, and adapt based on results.

**Previous experience managing social media or creating content for musicians, creators, entertainment, podcasts, or other personality-led brands is highly regarded.**

Contract, Schedule & Travel

This position will begin as an **initial 3-month, full-time contract**, with an expected commitment of approximately **40 hours per week**.

At the end of the initial three-month period, there may be an opportunity to continue or extend the role based on performance, fit, and the ongoing needs of the projects.

This is not necessarily a traditional Monday–Friday, 9–5 position. Artist schedules, releases, performances, travel, and social media opportunities can fall outside standard working hours, so flexibility is important.

Working days may occasionally include a **Saturday or Sunday**, particularly around releases, performances, shoots, events, travel, or other important moments. This does not mean working seven days per week; schedules will be structured so that working days can shift when weekend availability is required.

**Travel will be part of the role.** The successful candidate should be comfortable traveling with the artists when required, which may include domestic and international travel depending on schedules and opportunities.

Remuneration

**Remuneration is nego

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Social Media and Marketing Associate to join our innovative marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing engaging content, managing social media platforms, and executing digital marketing strategies that elevate brand awareness and foster meaningful connections with our audience. Your creativity and analytical skills will drive impactful campaigns, monitor performance metrics, and ensure our brand remains vibrant across all digital channels. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a forward-thinking organization committed to growth and excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Create compelling social media content tailored to various platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok, ensuring consistency with brand voice and messaging
* Manage daily social media activities using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer, scheduling posts, engaging with followers, and responding to comments to foster community engagement
* Develop and implement social media marketing campaigns that align with overall marketing goals and target audience interests
* Conduct social listening to monitor brand reputation, industry trends, and competitor activities, providing insights for strategic adjustments
* Utilize Adobe Creative Suite applications such as Photoshop and Illustrator for graphic design and media editing to produce eye-catching visuals
* Analyze social media performance metrics using analytics tools like Google Analytics and platform-specific insights to optimize content strategy and improve engagement rates
* Support public relations initiatives by crafting press releases, managing media relationships, and coordinating outreach efforts to enhance brand visibility
* Conduct keyword research and SEO best practices to improve content discoverability across digital channels
* Monitor digital marketing performance through detailed analytics reports, adjusting strategies based on data-driven insights

**Skills**

* Proficiency in social media platforms management including Facebook Advertising, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Campaigns, TikTok Ads, etc.
* Strong content creation skills with the ability to write engaging copy and produce multimedia content such as videos and photography
* Experience with graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and media editing software for high-quality visual production
* Knowledge of social listening tools and techniques for reputation management and trend analysis
* Familiarity with digital marketing analytics platforms including Google Analytics and web analytics tools for monitoring campaign success
* Ability to develop effective social media content marketing strategies that align with branding goals
* Excellent proofreading skills ensuring error-free content across all channels
* Strong relationship management skills for collaborating with internal teams and external partners
* Understanding of SEO principles and keyword research techniques to enhance online visibility
* Experience in public relations activities including media outreach, press release writing, and event promotion
* Ability to analyze media performance analytics and optimize campaigns for maximum impact

Join us as a Social Media and Marketing Associate if you’re passionate about storytelling through digital channels, eager to innovate in the fast-paced world of online marketing, and ready to make a tangible impact on our brand’s growth!

Pay: $17.50 - $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Time Critical Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
The **Time Critical Logistics Coordinator** is responsible for facilitating domestic and international freight across air transportation modes. They are a key liaison between customers, carriers, customs authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure freight moves efficiently, compliantly, and cost effectively from origin to destination. They are highly organized, detail oriented, and capable of managing multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment. They play a critical role in delivering exceptional service while supporting operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic and international freight shipments across air transportation modes.

* Manage the end-to-end forwarding process from shipment initiation through final delivery.

* Own the complete shipment process in CargoWise, including data entry, pickup and delivery scheduling, AES entry, airline bookings, routing, operational milestone updates, and costing.

* Ensure all customers' SOP instructions are adhered to, and internal/company KPIs and guidelines are and met.

* Prepare, review, and process shipping documentation including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, and other transportation documents.

* Communicate proactively with customers, carriers, customs brokers, steamship lines, airlines, trucking providers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and requirements.

* Track and monitor freight movements to ensure timely pickup, transit, customs clearance, and delivery.

* Support import and export compliance by maintaining accurate shipment records and ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and trade requirements.

* Coordinate customs clearance activities and work closely with customs brokers and government agencies as needed.

* Identify and resolve transportation delays, documentation discrepancies, customs holds, and other shipment-related issues.

* Provide customers with shipment updates, quotes, service options, and solutions to support their logistics needs.

* Maintain accurate data and shipment information within transportation management and operational systems.

* Assist with carrier selection, routing decisions, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

* Support continuous improvement efforts related to service levels, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and successful shipment execution.

* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

**Qualifications**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional logistics, transportation, supply chain, or business coursework preferred.

* Certification/Licensure: No specific certification required; industry certifications related to freight forwarding, import/export, customs, or logistics are a plus.

* Experience: 2+ years of direct experience in freight forwarding required

* Specialized experience in import operations, customs brokerage, and international logistics preferred.

* Experience supporting air freight operations strongly preferred.

* Prior working experience with CargoWise TMS and similar cloud-based transportation management/logistics platforms preferred.

* Working knowledge of international shipping documentation, transportation processes, and import/export procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build relationships across customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve shipment issues efficiently.

* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.

* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)

* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on-site setting (listed in this posting).

About OC Well Studio

OC Well Studio is an established boutique wellness practice in Newport Beach specializing in chiropractic care, acupuncture, dry needling, focused shockwave therapy, and therapeutic massage.

We're looking for an experienced, organized, and motivated individual to help run our practice and drive its continued growth.

This is more than a traditional front desk position. We're looking for someone who can take ownership of daily office operations, confidently manage insurance billing, create an exceptional patient experience, and actively contribute to our marketing and business development efforts.

The ideal candidate is proactive, tech-savvy, creative, and comfortable working independently in a small, collaborative environment.

What You'll Do

* Manage daily front desk operations, scheduling, patient communications, and office workflow.
* Deliver an exceptional patient experience from the initial inquiry through ongoing care.
* Handle incoming calls, appointment requests, cancellations, and patient follow-ups.
* Proactively manage provider schedules, fill openings, and encourage patient retention.
* Maintain efficient office systems, accurate records, and smooth day-to-day operations.

* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, including out-of-network coverage.
* Confidently explain deductibles, coinsurance, patient responsibility, and reimbursement processes.
* Submit and track insurance claims, review EOBs, resolve denials, and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Manage accounts receivable, patient balances, and billing inquiries.
* Ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and organized financial workflows.

**Marketing & Practice Growth**

* Create and manage engaging social media content, including Instagram posts, Reels, and stories.
* Assist with planning, launching, and monitoring Google and Meta advertising campaigns.
* Coordinate email and SMS marketing campaigns, promotions, and patient outreach.
* Update website content, Google Business Profile, and other online platforms.
* Help develop local partnerships, referral relationships, and community marketing initiatives.
* Track incoming leads, follow up with prospective patients, and help convert inquiries into bookings.
* Use AI tools and automations to improve marketing, patient communication, and office efficiency.
* Identify and implement opportunities to grow the practice.

What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of experience in a healthcare office, medical billing, or practice management role.
* Hands-on experience with insurance verification, claims processing, and accounts receivable.
* Strong understanding of medical insurance benefits, deductibles, and out-of-network billing.
* Experience creating social media content for a business.
* Excellent communication, organization, and multitasking skills.
* Comfortable with technology and learning new software.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve problems without constant direction.
* A genuine interest in marketing, patient experience, and business growth.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in chiropractic, physical therapy, acupuncture, or another outpatient healthcare setting.
* Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and digital marketing.
* Familiarity with Jane App, Canva, Squarespace, or email marketing platforms.
* Knowledge of Google Business Profile, local SEO, and marketing automation.
* Experience tracking business performance, lead conversions, and scheduling metrics.

You'll Be a Great Fit If...

* You're the type of person who sees something that needs to be done and takes care of it.
* You enjoy both the operational and creative sides of running a business.
* You're confident handling insurance questions and resolving billing issues.
* You understand that following up with leads, filling schedules, and retaining patients are essential to a successful practice.
* You're resourceful, dependable, detail-oriented, and motivated by results.
* You enjoy working in a smaller practice where your contributions make a meaningful impact.

Compensation & Benefits

* $27–$32/hour, depending on experience.
* Performance-based bonus opportunities tied to practice growth and operational goals.
* Approximately 20 hours per week, with potential for growth.
* Supportive, collaborative boutique wellness environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects and contribute directly to the success of an established practice.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction answering the following:

* What experience do you have with medical insurance billing, particularly out-of-network claims?
* What experience do you have with social media marketing, Google Ads, or Meta Ads?
* What interests you about a position that combines office management, patient experience, and marketing?

We look forward to hearing from you!

This role keeps our Parriott Wood cabinets, stone, and kitchen and bath products in stock by ordering from vendors, tracking shipments, and keeping purchasing records accurate. You'll communicate with vendors in English and Mandarin, compare pricing, and work closely with our warehouse and sales teams so customers get what they need on time. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY / OBJECTIVE**

The Account Manager is responsible for the overall ownership, growth, and execution of assigned customer accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients and is accountable for both **account performance (revenue, margin, and growth)** and **successful project delivery**.

This position builds upon the Project Manager role and **retains core project management responsibilities**, while adding full ownership of client relationships and financial performance. The Account Manager is expected to both **manage projects directly** and **oversee project execution across internal teams**, ensuring all work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Account Ownership & Growth**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, building and maintaining long-term relationships.
* Develop and execute account strategies to grow revenue and profitability.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Super Color’s product and service offerings.
* Meet or exceed assigned revenue and margin goals.
* Maintain and manage a pipeline of opportunities within existing accounts.

**Project Management & Execution (Core Responsibility)**

* Directly manage projects from quote stage through completion, maintaining full accountability for timelines, accuracy, and delivery.
* Perform all core Project Manager duties as needed, including:
* + Creating estimates and RFQs
  + Converting estimates into jobs (work orders)
  + Monitoring projects through production
  + Coordinating installations and vendors
* Act as the **final point of accountability** for all projects within assigned accounts, whether executed personally or delegated.
* Ensure all project details, specifications, and client expectations are clearly communicated and executed.

**Project Oversight & Team Coordination**

* Delegate project tasks to Project Managers or Junior Project Managers when appropriate.
* Oversee and support Project Managers to ensure consistent execution and quality.
* Conduct or participate in pre-production and RFQ meetings with Production, Estimating, and Management.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues impacting production, timelines, or client satisfaction.

**Client Management**

* Lead all client communications, including project updates, issue resolution, and strategic discussions.
* Set and manage client expectations regarding timelines, pricing, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular account reviews to ensure satisfaction and uncover growth opportunities.

**Estimating & Financial Responsibility**

* Create, review, and approve estimates and pricing strategies for assigned accounts.
* Ensure all projects meet margin and profitability targets.
* Negotiate pricing, scope, and timelines with clients as needed.
* Maintain accountability for account financial performance.

**Internal Leadership & Mentorship**

* Provide direction and guidance to Project Managers assigned to accounts.
* Assist in training and onboarding of Junior Project Managers.
* Act as a resource for escalation and problem-solving across teams.

**COMPENSATION STRUCTURE**

* Base salary + commission tied to:
* + Account revenue growth
  + Client retention and expansion

**COMPETENCIES**

* Account Management & Relationship Building
* Project Management (Execution & Oversight)
* Sales & Revenue Growth
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication Proficiency (Verbal & Written)
* Problem Solving / Decision Making
* Strong Sense of Ownership & Accountability
* Customer Service Excellence
* Financial Acumen (Margins, Pricing, Profitability)
* Operational & Production Awareness

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Indirect oversight of Project Managers and Junior Project Managers.
* Responsible for delegation and quality of work within assigned accounts.

**POSITION TYPE / EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

* Full-time position.
* This position requires on-site presence at Super Color Digital facilities and is not a remote role.
* Employees are expected to be in the office during standard business hours each workday to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Production, and Project Management teams.
* This role does not offer flexible or remote work arrangements, as consistent in-person communication is essential to successful project execution and account management.
* May require extended hours or occasional weekend work to support client deadlines and production schedules.

**EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS PREFERRED**

* 5+ years of experience in Project Management, Account Management, or related field.
* Experience in print, graphics, manufacturing, or related industry preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage both client relationships and project execution.
* Strong understanding of production workflows and estimating processes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**KEY ROLE CLARIFICATION**

* This is **not a pure sales role**.
* This is **not a pure project management role**.
* This is a **hybrid ownership role** responsible for:
* + Client relationship
  + Revenue growth
  + Project execution

jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**Specialist, Business Operations & Events**

San Francisco, California

Barry’s is the Best Workout in the WorldTM®. Founded in West Hollywood in 1998, it’s the original strength and cardio interval fitness experience that provides an immersive, high-intensity, one-hour workout that’s as effective as it is fun. Our fitness classes alternate between working out with weights and running on a treadmill. Each day focuses on a different muscle group in order to achieve real results and to prevent injuries. Barry's grows one first class at a time. Someone walks in, finds their spot in the Red Room, and leaves knowing they'll be back. Your job is to create as many of those first classes as possible.

You'll own local event marketing across the New York market- in-studio community nights and bring-a-friend classes, plus out-of-studio pop-ups, run clubs, and partnerships with local brands, employers, and buildings. Every event is measured the same way: how many people took their first class because of it, and how many came back.

**Qualifications**

  

* 4+ years in community, field, or event marketing- ideally fitness, wellness, hospitality, or a consumer brand with physical locations
* A track record of events tied to hard acquisition numbers, not just attendance
* Deep familiarity with New York and existing local relationships you can activate
* Strong project management and comfort with data
* Willingness to be hands-on and in studio
* Reliable local transportation and the ability to lift and haul event materials- this is a physical, on-your-feet role across multiple sites in a single day

72,000 - 75,000 USD per year(NorCal)

WCI Electric – Santa Clara, CA  
Part-Time or Full-Time | 20–40 Hours Per Week  
$30–$40 Per Hour, Based on Experience

ABOUT THE POSITION

WCI Electric is a small, family-owned electrical contracting company serving the Silicon Valley area. We are currently owner-operated and looking for a dependable, highly organized person who can become the owner’s right hand by helping manage both business operations and personal responsibilities.

This is not a traditional receptionist position. The right person will help bring organization, follow-through and structure to a busy electrical contracting business while also assisting with personal scheduling, household coordination and occasional errands.

The position can range from 20 to 40 hours per week depending on the candidate’s experience, capabilities and availability. For the right person, this has the potential to develop into a long-term operations-management position as the company grows.

BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage and prioritize email, phone messages and daily follow-ups
* Schedule service calls, site visits and customer appointments
* Communicate with customers regarding scheduling and project status
* Organize information needed for estimates and invoices
* Follow up on outstanding estimates, invoices and customer approvals
* Assist with QuickBooks Online data entry and administrative tasks
* Coordinate permits, material orders, deliveries and vendor paperwork
* Track project documents, change orders, deposits and closeout items
* Organize hiring applications and schedule candidate interviews
* Assist with customer review requests and business-development outreach
* Maintain an organized list of tasks requiring the owner’s attention
* Help develop simple systems that prevent important items from being overlooked

PERSONAL AND HOUSEHOLD RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage personal appointments, reminders and calendar items
* Coordinate household repairs, service providers and organizing projects
* Obtain and compare vendor quotes
* Handle returns, purchases and occasional local errands
* Assist with vehicle service, property maintenance and travel planning
* Organize personal documents and ongoing projects

This is not a housekeeping, childcare or caregiving position.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Exceptionally organized, dependable and trustworthy
* Comfortable working directly with a busy small-business owner
* Able to take loosely explained information and turn it into a clear action plan
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Professional and comfortable communicating with customers, contractors and vendors
* Able to work independently and follow assignments through to completion
* Discreet with confidential business and personal information
* Comfortable adjusting priorities when urgent issues arise

COMPENSATION

The successful person will reduce the number of unfinished tasks, keep customers and vendors informed, ensure important follow-ups happen and help the owner remain focused on electrical work, estimating and company growth.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
