jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategy, growth, and overall health of a book of 8–12 of Ramp’s largest and most strategic customers. You’ll own the long-term relationship and be accountable for maintaining and growing revenue, driving product adoption, and ensuring your customers achieve meaningful business outcomes on Ramp.

You’ll build deep relationships across all levels of your customers’ organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives, and be skilled at managing complex stakeholder dynamics and product configurations. Internally, you’ll partner closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams at Ramp to strengthen our B2B relationships, coordinate strategic initiatives, and feed structured insights into our product roadmap and internal processes.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own a portfolio of 8–12 strategic Enterprise customers, with clear accountability for retention, expansion, and overall account health
* Maintain and grow revenue and usage within your book of business by identifying, pitching, and executing on upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Build and execute detailed account and territory plans, including QBRs and executive reviews that highlight results, surface risks, and align on future growth
* Lead frequent customer conversations (status calls, roadmap discussions, upsell conversations, and QBRs) to ensure customers are achieving strong outcomes with Ramp
* Own end-to-end execution of renewals and expansions, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and close
* Serve as a Ramp product expert, proactively uncovering workflow gaps and recommending solutions that save customers time and money, while guiding them toward deeper platform adoption
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, CSMs, and Solutions to coordinate customer initiatives and deliver tailored, enterprise-grade solutions
* Provide structured feedback to product and leadership teams, translating customer needs and patterns into recommendations that shape Ramp’s Strategic and Enterprise roadmap
* Navigate and align internal and external stakeholders, including C-suite executives, investors, partners, and cross-functional teams
* Use data and analytics to inform your strategy, monitor account performance, and communicate impact and opportunities in a clear, grounded way

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 9+ years of experience as a Account Manager or Account Executive
* 3+ years managing strategic Enterprise accounts (2,500+ employees or Fortune 1000) with proven commercial ownership
* Strong familiarity with Fintech, Payments, Finance/Accounting, or B2B SaaS products
* Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex six-figure renewals and upsells
* Ability to understand and communicate complex product workflows, integrations, and technical configurations
* High fluency in financial value drivers — able to articulate ROI, payback periods, process modernization, and cost savings
* Deep sense of ownership with the ability to build processes, playbooks, and documentation from 0 1 as strategic customers push the limits of Ramp’s platform and require new, scalable solutions
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally and at the C-suite
* Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced environments
* Operates with urgency, grit, and ownership; thrives in environments with innovation, change, and ambiguity
* Willingness to travel for customer on-sites, events, and internal team summits

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience in financial services sales or selling to finance teams (e.g., Office of the CFO, accounting, controllers, expense management).
* Experience at a high-growth startup

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

***About Tilray Brands, Inc.***

***Tilray Brands, Inc.*** (“Tilray”) (Nasdaq: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), is leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection. In this role you will be responsible for building strong relationships with our customers and forging indelible connections between brands and consumers by making our products available, visible, relevant, recommended, and perfectly enjoyed every time. Our ambition is to reinvigorate the craft beer sector, becoming the fastest growing craft beer suppliers in the U.S. To achieve this, we need the very best talent on our team. Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you. If you are a self-starter who knows how to work and play hard, and you have an unwavering passion for independent, craft beer; grab your kayak and hop in the river with us!

  

**Summary:** Drive market growth by working with our Distributors to actively manage annual business plans including volume, retail distribution and relevant, in-market events and promotions. Our Field Sales Representatives are focused on our off- and on-premise accounts and will represent our beverage alcohol portfolio including: SweetWater Brewing Company, Montauk Brewing Company, Alpine Beer Company, Green Flash Brewing Company, Shock Top, Blue Point Brewing Co., Breckenridge Brewery, 10 Barrel Brewing Co., Redhook Brewery, Widmer Brothers Brewing, Square Mile Cider Company and lastly Hiball, a no alcohol, clean energy seltzer made with zero sugar, zero calories, and organic caffeine.

Four out of five days will be spent in the field visiting accounts, with an expectation of 10–15 account visits per day.

Sales / Indirect Customer Success

*8000 Marina Blvd #300, Brisbane, CA 94005, Verenigde Staten*

Build and maintain relationships with multiple customers! We’ll train you on Odoo’s diverse applications, and you’ll use your business understanding to drive adoption and expand your client base.

Odoo is an open-source enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform that helps companies manage and streamline their operations through a single, integrated system. Our modular suite of business applications—covering everything from accounting and inventory to CRM and project management—works together seamlessly to support efficiency and growth.

  

***To help us provide the best candidate experience, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AS A PDF and limit your applications to a maximum of 3 within a 12-month period.***

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship responsibilities for employment visas at this time.***

### **About the Job**

**Hybrid (4 days onsite, 1 day remote) – Brisbane, CA**

As a Customer Success Manager, you will manage a portfolio of direct Odoo customers and serve as a trusted advisor throughout their customer journey.

Your mission is to help customers maximize the value of Odoo by driving adoption, building long-term relationships, and helping them achieve their business goals. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience, drive retention and renewals, and identify growth opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys relationship management, problem-solving, and helping businesses improve their operations through technology.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own and proactively manage a portfolio of direct customers across the North American market, serving as their primary point of contact throughout the customer journey
* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of their business goals and operational needs
* Drive product adoption and engagement through proactive outreach, strategic account management, and guidance on Odoo best practices
* Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to assess customer health, satisfaction, business outcomes, and long-term success
* Proactively identify and mitigate churn risks, driving customer retention, successful renewals, and billing and revenue goals
* Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities for additional Odoo applications based on customer needs
* Partner with internal Consulting, Support, Sales, and Product teams to resolve issues and improve customer outcomes
* Advocate for customers by sharing feedback and insights with internal stakeholders to help improve the overall customer experience

### **Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, SaaS, ERP, or another client-facing role
* Fluency in English and French (professional or native/bilingual: reading, writing, and speaking)
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
* Strong business acumen and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Customer-first mindset with a proactive, consultative approach
* Interest in technology and business process optimization

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with ERP, CRM, or SaaS platforms
* Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience working with SMB or mid-market customers
* Additional language skills, particularly French, Spanish, or Dutch

### **How does it work in Sales?**

Our Sales Department is divided into two parts: Direct & Indirect Sales.

In Direct Sales, we work in direct contact with SMEs. In Indirect Sales, we collaborate with Partners (Odoo resellers).

### **What's great in the job?**

* Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, 401K Matching, and Commuter Benefits
* PTO (Paid-time-off), paid sick days, and paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program: 3 X 1-hour telehealth calls with certified mental health professionals
* Evolve in a nice working atmosphere with a passionate, growing team!
* Snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap!
* Chef-prepared lunches - snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap!
* Company-sponsored events for groups of 6+ employees

The estimated annual compensation range for this role is $70,000-$90,000 OTE(on-target earnings), with a base salary range of $50,000-$70,000. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.

*Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Odoo's values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records**.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**Dealpath is looking for a self-motivated Customer Success Manager to join our growing team in New York City or San Francisco!**

As a Senior CSM at Dealpath, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts, typically 30 to 40, for firms like Blackstone, MetLife, and Nuveen. Your customers are investment professionals and executive stakeholders who rely on Dealpath to run how they deploy capital. You'll take on the most complex accounts, mentor other CSMs, and help shape how the team operates.

### **Qualifications:**

* **Proven renewal and upsell experience**, end to end, not supporting someone else's process
* **Enterprise account experience**, multi-year contracts and executive-level stakeholders
* **QBR/EBR experience**, comfortable leading data-driven business reviews
* **Clear, polished communicator**, skilled at building credibility with C-suite stakeholders including CIOs and Heads of Acquisitions
* **Excel/Google Sheets proficiency**, you'll use it regularly
* **Curiosity about AI**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in CRE tech, proptech, or adjacent financial technology (alternative investment platforms, private capital software)
* Background supporting a complex, configurable SaaS product requiring deep domain expertise
* Familiarity with the CRE acquisition process
* Salesforce experience

**The Perks & Culture:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy.
* Commuter benefits program.
* Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well-being.

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. jobs.title: Sales Development Lead (SDR Lead)
jobs.description:
**About Stuut**
===============

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.

Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.

Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai.

**Sales Development Lead**

The Sales Development Lead will partner with the Sales Development Manager to build and coach the team that opens every door for us. You'll help hire, coach, and run our Sales Development Representatives, whose job is to qualify and convert leads for our Account Executives' calendars.

You'll spend most of your day on the floor ,listening to calls, running huddles, coaching reps in the moment. This role will report to the SDR Manager

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the team's weekly and monthly qualified-meeting targets, show rates, and meeting-to-close contribution.
* Assist with Recruiting, interviewing, and ramping SDRs on an aggressive growth plan.
* Coach daily. Live call listening, recorded call reviews, role plays, and one-on-ones with clear development plans for every rep.
* Partner with the SDR Manager for daily operating cadence — morning huddles, activity tracking, end-of-day reviews — and hold the team to high standards on volume, speed-to-lead, and CRM hygiene.
* Report clearly to the SDR Manager on pipeline created, team performance, and what's working or not.

**Qualifications**

We care about how you lead as much as what you've done. The ideal candidate has carried a phone quota, then built and coached a team that beat one.

**Required**

* 1+ years in sales
* 1+ year managing or leading SDRs, BDRs, or an inside sales team.
* A track record of hitting team targets through coaching and process.
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and ramping early-career salespeople at pace.
* Strong command of outbound and inbound prospecting mechanics: cadences, speed-to-lead, qualification, disposition discipline.
* Fluent with CRM systems, dialers, and sales engagement tools; comfortable building reports and reading a dashboard.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You coach, you don't just manage. Your reps get measurably better every month, and they can tell you exactly what you're working on with them.
* You're on the floor. You lead from the middle of the room, not from a conference call.
* You're competitive. You keep score for the team and you take a miss personally.
* You're resilient. Early-career reps struggle, quit, and surprise you. You reset and keep the standard high.
* You're a teammate. You want the AEs to win as much as your own team, and you build that into how SDRs work.
* You take ownership. The team's number is your number.

**Nice to Have**

* Competitive background, you've been coached hard and you know how to coach.
* Experience in high-velocity consumer sales (education, youth programs, fitness, coaching, insurance, or similar).
* Experience standing up an SDR team from a small group to a large one.

**Compensation**

* Top-of-market salary and equity package
* Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)
* Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you
* 401(k) & Match
* Equity
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave

**Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

jobs.description:
About Us:  
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Curriculum Program Coordinator is an entry-level professional responsible for administering assigned curriculum processes and supporting the delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement of the medical education program. Working within established academic policies, accreditation standards, and departmental guidelines, the Coordinator evaluates curriculum information, identifies and resolves routine issues, recommends corrective action, and advises faculty and staff on curriculum-management requirements and systems. Matters involving significant academic, policy, or compliance decisions are escalated to the appropriate leader.

**Curriculum Management, Operations, and Reporting**

* Administer assigned curriculum processes in accordance with approved academic policies, program objectives, accreditation standards, and departmental procedures.
* Review curriculum content, learning objectives, instructional methodologies, assessment information, and curriculum-map alignments for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Maintain approved curriculum, course, assessment, and attendance information in the curriculum management system, learning management system, and related educational platforms.
* Coordinate the implementation and tracking of approved curricular revisions, including reviewing documentation, monitoring deadlines, and recommending follow-up or corrective action.
* Monitor curriculum workflows and course readiness; independently resolve routine issues and escalate exceptions requiring academic or policy decisions.
* Analyze and summarize curriculum data for program reviews, accreditation activities, self-studies, and institutional reports.
* Investigate data discrepancies and determine or recommend appropriate corrections before information is used for reporting or decision-making.
* Coordinate course schedules, academic calendars, attendance requirements, and related operational needs; identify conflicts and facilitate resolution.
* Document procedures and recommend improvements to curriculum workflows, tracking tools, communications, and data controls.

**Faculty, Course, and Assessment Coordination**

* Collaborate with Course Directors, faculty, assessment staff, and curriculum colleagues to maintain alignment among course content, learning objectives, assessments, and program outcomes.
* Advise faculty and staff on established curriculum-management procedures, course-site standards, system functionality, and appropriate courses of action.
* Coordinate faculty onboarding, training, curriculum communications, course materials, and educational resources.
* Partner with Course Directors to administer assigned courses in the learning management system, evaluate course readiness, and address content or configuration concerns.
* Coordinate with the Instructional Designer on course design, pedagogy, instructional development, and educational technology matters outside the Coordinator’s authority.
* Manage assigned curriculum projects and educational initiatives, monitor progress, and recommend actions supporting timely completion.
* Provide administrative and logistical coordination for curriculum-related meetings, faculty-development activities, active-learning sessions, assessments, course materials, purchasing, and payment activities, as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
* Up to two years of relevant experience in academic administration, program coordination, curriculum administration, student services, educational technology, data administration, or a related area. Relevant internship or graduate-assistant experience may be considered.
* Ability to interpret and apply policies, evaluate detailed information, identify discrepancies, and recommend appropriate action.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, problem-solving, and professional service skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently within established guidelines.
* Proficiency with databases, spreadsheets, learning or curriculum management systems, and standard office applications.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with faculty, students, administrators, and staff from diverse backgrounds.

Additional Information: In compliance with NYC's Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary range for this position is listed below. Albert Einstein College of Medicine considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and organizational considerations when extending an offer. Minimum Salary Range: USD $66,300.00/Yr. Maximum Salary Range: USD $71,000.00/Yr.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility, and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on-street bicycle facilities (1,200+ lane-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility unit seeks to hire a Program Coordinator to support the launch and implementation of the Secure Bike Program (SBP). Over the next five years, NYC DOT will install 500 secure bike parking facilities, creating thousands of safe, convenient bicycle parking spaces across New York City. This initiative will make cycling more accessible and practical by supporting ownership of a wide range of bicycles, including cargo bikes, adaptive bikes, and UL-certified e-bikes. Under the supervision of the Senior Program Manager, the Program Coordinator will play a key role in the deployment and operation of SBP facilities citywide. The candidate will identify technically viable locations for SBP installation through field investigations and site evaluations and review installation plans to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements. The candidate will maintain and manage accurate databases to ensure data accuracy and integrity, develop data collection protocols, assist with performance reporting, and oversee pre-installation notifications and post-installation inspections and reporting. The candidate will create maps using ArcGIS and produce presentations and outreach materials using Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft PowerPoint for senior leadership, stakeholders, and the public. The candidate will liaise with internal divisions, sister agencies, and community stakeholders to facilitate installations and activations. The candidate will support public education and engagement efforts related to program goals and facility types, including presentations to community members and promotion at outreach events. The candidate will also respond to inquiries and support communication efforts related to SBP. The candidate will perform additional planning, analysis, and operational tasks related to the implementation and ongoing management of the Secure Bike Program, as needed.
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative professional with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team and demonstrate a willingness to conduct fieldwork year-round while traveling by bicycle, on foot, or via public transit.
  
  
The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

* Assist with both personal and professional scheduling.
* Track deadlines, outstanding tasks, and ongoing projects.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, reservations, errands, and other personal-assistant needs as required.
* Research vendors, services, products, and business opportunities.
* Maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling personal, client, and business information.

With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people.

Pritchard Industries is seeking to hire a **Project Manager** to oversee, coordinate, and supervise comprehensive Vendor Management Services for two major NYC institutional facilities totaling over 100,000 sq. ft. each. The Project Manager will serve as the primary on-site and operational point of contact for the New York City Administration for Children's Services (ACS). You will be responsible for overseeing subcontracted vendors, managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, driving preventative maintenance and cost-avoidance strategies, maintaining strict regulatory compliance, and ensuring 24/7/365 continuous operational readiness across both properties.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Vendor & Subcontractor Supervision**

* Supervise, inspect, and coordinate the performance of all subcontracted vendors working on the properties.
* Ensure all vendor work complies with manufacturer recommendations, NYC Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) standards, and applicable NYC/NYS laws.
* Direct competitive procurement for third-party services: solicit and document a minimum of 3 written estimates for purchases over $15,000 and conduct market research for purchases between $5,000 and $15,000.
* Coordinate seamlessly with other city-engaged contractors to prevent work interference or operational friction.

**2. Facilities & MEP Operations**

* Manage off-site and on-demand building engineering services for MEP, elevator, generator, HVAC, lighting, and fire/safety systems during normal business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).
* Dispatch emergency response staff on-site within **1 hour** for any off-hours system operational failures.
* Conduct an annual Property Analysis and execute an ACS-approved Cost Avoidance & Preventative Maintenance Program.
* Oversee hot/cold water chemical treatments, sanitation, and boiler feed water pH levels in compliance with OSHA MSDS guidelines.
* Implement and manage an Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) program, including annual IAQ reporting, biennial facility inspections, and rapid air testing within 24 hours of suspected issues.

**3. Safety, Emergency Plans & Compliance**

* Review, update, or create Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) and evacuation procedures annually in coordination with ACS and site staff.
* Ensure compliance with all FDNY and NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) regulations, particularly regarding elevator and life safety equipment.
* Support, coordinate and document required emergency drills (e.g., evacuation, shelter-in-place).

**4. Recordkeeping, Logs & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive daily operating logs, physical inventory controls, warranty files, and a dedicated maintenance library.
* Monitor security surveillance system operability (cameras, hardware, software) and report status summaries to ACS at designated intervals.
* Prepare and present reports for oversight entities (e.g., NYS Office of Children and Family Services, NYS Commission of Correction, NYC Council) upon request.
* Implement and maintain ACS-approved Facility Management Software systems.

**5. Labor & Financial Administration**

* Enforce compliance with NYS Labor Law Sections 220 / 231 (Prevailing Wage / Living Wage regulations).
* Ensure all site workers complete 10-hour OSHA construction safety certifications, display laminated photo ID badges, and sign daily sign-in logs.
* Submit detailed monthly expense reports, payroll certifications, and original payroll transcripts to ACS.
* Promptly investigate and submit full written reports on non-compliance notices, accidents, claims, or significant facility incidents within 24 hours.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education:**

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

The next chapter of Ramp's growth runs straight through the customers we already have: 80,000+ finance teams who adopted us for one thing and haven't yet seen what the rest of the platform can do for them. Account Management owns that opportunity - and this role owns the team building the motion to capture it.

You'll lead a group of 5-8 Account Managers, each carrying a book of ~3,000 emerging and SMB customers with real latitude over how they grow it. * Represent Account Management cross-functionally, partnering with Sales, CX, CSM, Risk, and Product to remove blockers and drive outcomes.

**What You’ll Need**

* Minimum 2+ years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record of exceeding goals (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)
* Minimum 1+ years building and leading account management or sales teams, with a track record of exceeding goal (new business or cross-sell/upsell experience mandatory)
* Prior success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS or AI companies

* Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value to customers, including executive leaders
* Proficiency with data analytics tools (Salesforce, Looker, Excel) and a bias toward using data to drive decisions
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, backed by excellent communication and presentation ability
* High agency and adaptability - no two days are the same, and the only constant is change

jobs.description:
**About Linked Security**

Linked Security is a Brooklyn-based security systems integrator that has been protecting New York homes, buildings, and businesses for more than 10 years. We design, install, and maintain security cameras, intercoms and buzzer systems, access control, alarms, structured cabling, A/V, and networking, and we run an in-house locksmith service. Our clients range from brownstone owners and property managers to retail chains, offices, and multi-unit residential buildings. We're known for fast response times, honest pricing, and doing the job right. We're growing, and we're looking for a sales professional to help us grow faster.

**The Role**

As our Account Manager / Sales Representative, you'll own the full sales cycle, from finding new clients to closing deals and keeping existing accounts happy and expanding. You'll work closely with our technicians and project team to turn customer needs into well-designed, accurately quoted security solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, walking buildings, and building long-term relationships.

Compensation: Competitive base salary of **$48,000 – $60,000** plus uncapped commission.

**What You'll Do**

* Generate and pursue new business with property managers, building owners, management companies, contractors, retailers, offices, and homeowners across the five boroughs.
* Conduct site surveys with our technical team to assess security needs and recommend the right mix of cameras, intercoms, access control, alarms, and A/V.
* Prepare clear proposals and quotes, and follow up through close.
* Manage a portfolio of existing accounts, identifying upsell opportunities like system upgrades, service contracts, and additional sites.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Traba is building a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We started by connecting warehouses, manufacturers, and distributors with reliable workers, and hundreds of operators now run their sites on Traba. Now we're scaling our new AI product, Neo, that helps those operators run their entire operation more efficiently. We're backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

As a Customer Success Manager for Neo, you'll own the sale of Traba's AI product for warehouse and 3PL operators. You'll sell to owners, COOs, and finance leaders, building the ROI case for how Neo moves their P&L and closing deals that grow into the six figures. You won't be starting cold. Traba's staffing relationships give you warm access to operators who already trust us. You'll work directly with leadership, product, and engineering to shape the GTM motion, and what you learn in the field will shape what we build next.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

* **Run pilots that convert**

  + Lead pilot kickoffs. Agree on quantifiable success criteria, a pilot roadmap and a target number of active users with the customer
  + Keep each pilot pacing to plan. Spot slippage early and fix it with the customer and the FDE
  + Drive pilots to on-time conversion. Build the business case and run the conversion conversation with the economic buyer
* **Drive adoption and usage**

  + Onboard business users and get them back into Neo week after week.
  + Track adoption weekly: active and returning users, interactions, time in product. Act on the trend for each account
  + Know when low app usage is a win, such as when an agent does the work or the output lands outside Neo
* **Grow accounts**

  + Find new use cases during and after the pilot. Take them from idea to pilot to live
  + Expand into new users, teams and sites within existing customers
  + Own expansion revenue for your book
* **Be the voice of the customer**

  + Bring patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, with clear asks and priorities
  + Spend real time on site. Learn the floor, the shifts and the people who run them
  + Help shape the Neo CS playbook as we scale: kickoff templates, success plans, QBRs, health scores

**Qualifications and Skills:**
==============================

* 3–5+ years in customer success, account management, solutions consulting or implementation at a B2B SaaS or AI startup
* Comfort with data. You can read usage trends, build a simple dashboard and tell a clear story with numbers
* Strong stakeholder management, from Managers to C-suite
* Ownership. You run your book like a business and don't wait for a playbook
* Willingness to travel to customer sites

**Benefits**
============

* Start-up equity
* Competitive Salary
* 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

**Salary Range Details**

The compensation range for this position is set between $120,000 and $150,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. We also provided a very competitive equity package on top of base.

The position is based onsite in New York City, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. **Our Values**
==============

**Dream Big -** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

**Olympian’s Work Ethic -** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
jobs.description:
About Torch Dental

Torch Dental is a high-growth, venture-backed vertical SaaS company transforming how dental practices run their businesses. Our mission is to give every dental office the modern software, automation, and visibility they need to operate efficiently and profitably.

We are launching our second product in 2026 and will be expanding into the broader practice-operations layers such as Revenue Cycle Management, Finance, HR, payroll, benefits, and back-office workflows—building toward a full dental practice operating system.

Torch Dental is at the Series B stage with strong revenue growth, rapidly expanding products, and a profitable core business. As an RCM Customer Success Manager you’ll play a critical role in shaping the customer experience for our AI-powered revenue cycle management product, partnering closely with dental practices to drive successful adoption, deliver measurable outcomes and help build the foundation for how we scale RCM Customer Success.

About the role

Torch Revenue Cycle Management is Torch Dental's second product: an AI-enabled revenue cycle management platform that helps dental practices. We're launching the product to single practices, multi-location groups and emerging DSOs. We're hiring our first dedicated Customer Success Manager for this product to own the customer relationship end-to-end: from kickoff and payer/PMS setup, through go-live, through ongoing retention and expansion.

What you'll do

* Own onboarding for new RCM customers: lead kickoff calls, and guide practices through going live and continuing to engage with the platform.
* Be the primary point of contact for a growing book of RCM accounts — spanning solo practices, groups, and emerging DSOs — through go-live, steady-state usage, and renewal.
* Be the customer's advocate internally: feed structured feedback to Product and Engineering on integration issues, payer coverage gaps, and workflow pain points, and to Sales on expansion and DSO opportunities.
* Help build the playbook: since this is a new, high-touch, fast-scaling function, you'll help define onboarding scripts, health-score criteria, and escalation processes as much as execute them.
* Partner closely with the RCM sales, product, and billing-ops team during the handoff from sales-closed to customer-live, and take that ownership off their plates.
* Handle the compliance-sensitive parts of onboarding correctly — BAAs, PMS credentials, payer portal access — in a HIPAA-aware way.

What we're looking for

**Required:**

* 3–5+ years in a customer success, account management, or implementation role, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling SaaS environment.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: this is a first-of-its-kind role at Torch, without an existing playbook, on a product that is itself still early and evolving.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be explaining claims and billing concepts to dental office staff and translating customer workflows back to engineering and product.
* Strong tech competency - you will be working directly with customers on integrating several solutions and will need to do basic tech implementation. You should feel comfortable with tech and learning new solutions.
* Process-builder mindset: comfortable creating and iterating on onboarding scripts, health-score frameworks, and escalation paths rather than inheriting a mature one.
* Familiarity with dental practice management systems (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, or similar) is a strong plus; comfort learning new PMS and payer systems quickly is required.

**Nice to have:**

* Background as a dental or medical biller, RCM specialist, or practice manager.
* Direct, hands-on experience with dental or medical billing / revenue cycle workflows — you know what an EOB, ERA, clearinghouse, and payer portal are, and ideally have touched claims submission or payment posting yourself.
* Experience supporting healthcare or dental customers through a HIPAA-regulated onboarding process (BAAs, PHI handling).
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for account and health tracking.
* Experience working with DSOs (dental support organizations) or multi-location group practices.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Executive Assistants
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  
  
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  
  
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.  
  
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  
  
Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**The Role**
------------

Legora is an AI-native legal software company at an inflection point. We're scaling from a lean startup and our leadership team is growing across four continents.

This is a true leadership role and your chance to shape how world-class support looks from the inside, and make AI and automation core to how executive support gets done. EAs are the connective tissue of any high-functioning executive team. Right now, we have strong individual EAs, but we need someone to build the system: the standards, the playbooks, the culture.

If you want to build something that lasts, work with leaders who value you, and see your fingerprints on how a real company operates, this is it!

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Lead a distributed EA team across four offices and time zones.** You'll run the team as one cohesive unit: establish the rhythm (team meetings, 1:1s, regular retrospectives), build the culture that keeps people connected as you grow, and make sure knowledge and best practice flow freely between EAs.
* **Co-own the Legora EA operating system with the CEO Office.** You'll develop and live in playbooks for calendar principles, travel, expenses, meeting prep, inbox handling, and cross-team coverage.
* **Lead the automation and AI initiative from EA work.** You'll identify where automation adds real value, pilot new tools with your team, and turn what works into the standard. This means staying curious about new tools, running small experiments, and building a team that sees AI as part of the job.
* **Grow the team with the company.** You'll work with the Chief of Staff and People team to hire EAs who match the company's growth: planning capacity before new executives join, running recruitment end to end, and making sure each EA is paired with the right executive(s). You'll also run the two-week onboarding sprint so every new EA has full access, context, and relationships by day ten.
* **Global Coverage so no executive is ever without support.** You coordinate coverage when EAs are out or traveling, balance load across time zones, adjust matches as the org evolves, and partner with People and IT so new executives get a smooth handoff. You're the escalation point when something breaks, resolving it calmly, and feeding what you learn back into how the team works.
* **Develop every EA.** set clear expectations, hold regular 1:1s, and give direct feedback. Partner with each executive on their EA's performance and development, and build growth paths so strong EAs see a future in the team.

**What You Bring**

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**Dealpath is looking for a self-motivated Customer Success Manager to join our growing team in New York City or San Francisco!**

As a Senior CSM at Dealpath, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts, typically 30 to 40, for firms like Blackstone, MetLife, and Nuveen. Your customers are investment professionals and executive stakeholders who rely on Dealpath to run how they deploy capital. You'll take on the most complex accounts, mentor other CSMs, and help shape how the team operates.

### **You're excited about this opportunity because you'll:**

* **Manage a book of business:** 30-40 enterprise accounts as the primary relationship holder for investment teams and C-suite stakeholders.
* **Drive adoption and value:** Define success criteria early and make sure every customer can articulate what Dealpath is doing for their business.
* **Lead QBRs and EBRs:** Data-driven business reviews that keep customers aligned and build the case for renewal.
* **Lead renewals end to end:** Build the case well before the contract date, not at the finish line.
* **Identify and grow upsell opportunities:** Grounded in a deep understanding of each customer's investment strategy.
* **Be the voice of your customers internally:** Synthesize feedback to product, engineering, and sales.
* **Develop genuine CRE expertise:** Advise customers on configuring Dealpath to their workflows and become a trusted subject matter expert.
* **Stay close to our AI roadmap:** Our customers are actively asking about AI and our CSMs are on the front lines of how it lands.

### **Qualifications:**

* **1.5+ years** as a CSM or Client Success Manager at a B2B SaaS company, direct account ownership, not a team management role
* **Proven renewal and upsell experience**, end to end, not supporting someone else's process
* **Enterprise account experience**, multi-year contracts and executive-level stakeholders
* **QBR/EBR experience**, comfortable leading data-driven business reviews
* **Clear, polished communicator**, skilled at building credibility with C-suite stakeholders including CIOs and Heads of Acquisitions
* **Excel/Google Sheets proficiency**, you'll use it regularly
* **Curiosity about AI**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in CRE tech, proptech, or adjacent financial technology (alternative investment platforms, private capital software)
* Background supporting a complex, configurable SaaS product requiring deep domain expertise
* Familiarity with the CRE acquisition process
* Salesforce experience

**The Perks & Culture:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy.
* Commuter benefits program.
* Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well-being.
* Hybrid Work Policy, 3 days in office (Tues/Wed/Thur).
* The estimated pay range for New York City, New York candidates is $110,000-$115,000 + equity. Eligible for variable incentive compensation with a target incentive equal to 20% of OTE. OTE range: $137,500-$150,000.
* Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.
* Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.
* Interviews may include AI-assisted note-taking tools in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**About Dealpath**:

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.  
  
By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.  
  
Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.  
  
We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture — we'd love to meet you!

**Interview Process Notice**

Dealpath conducts interviews via video conference. To support our interviewers with accurate note-taking, we may use AI-assisted transcription tools during your interview sessions. By participating in the interview process, you acknowledge that interviews may be recorded or transcribed using these tools for note-taking purposes only. Transcripts are used solely for internal evaluation and are not shared outside of the hiring team.

**Company:** MYLAR LEGENDS

We're not looking for someone who simply follows trends. **WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CREATES THEM.**

We need a marketing professional who brings fresh ideas to the table, isn't afraid to think outside the box, and has the confidence and personality to turn those ideas into real results.

* **DEVELOP BRAND AWARENESS:** Find creative ways to introduce MYLAR LEGENDS to new audiences.

* A creative mind that consistently generates fresh, exciting, and original ideas.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.
* A positive attitude, professional appearance, and strong work ethic.
* Passion for branding, creativity, marketing, and business growth.

**BONUS SKILLS:**

* Experience with influencer marketing and brand partnerships.
* Photography, videography, or video editing experience.
* Knowledge of Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar creative tools.
* Experience organizing promotional events or product launches.
* Experience with paid digital advertising and social media analytics.

WE DON'T WANT SOMEONE WHO JUST THINKS OF IDEAS. WE WANT SOMEONE WHO MAKES THEM HAPPEN.

This is not a position where you'll sit behind a desk doing the same thing every day.

One day, you might be creating content for a new product launch.

The next, you could be meeting potential business partners, filming social media content, attending an event, or developing an exciting new campaign.

**EVERY DAY BRINGS SOMETHING DIFFERENT.**

We're looking for someone who is excited by that challenge.

Someone who can walk into a room full of strangers and confidently start a conversation.

Someone whose creativity doesn't stop when the workday ends.

Someone who sees opportunities where others don't.

**WE WANT A PERSONALITY THAT STANDS OUT AND IDEAS THAT MAKE AN IMPACT.**

WHY JOIN MYLAR LEGENDS?

* Have the opportunity to bring your own marketing ideas to life.

* Make a direct impact on the growth and visibility of our brand.

THINK YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES?

When applying, please submit:

**DON'T JUST TELL US YOU'RE CREATIVE. SHOW US!**

If you have the experience, personality, confidence, and drive to make big things happen, **APPLY TODAY!**

**MYLAR LEGENDS – WHERE CREATIVITY MEETS OPPORTUNITY.**

Expected hours: 50.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

**Join Related’s Talent Acquisition team in New York as a Recruiting Coordinator!**

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in the full hiring process, from coordinating interviews and delivering an exceptional candidate experience to facilitating onboarding and supporting the day-to-day operations of our recruiting function. You’ll also contribute to the business side of Talent Acquisition, managing vendor relationships, tracking expenses, supporting reporting, and helping keep our processes running efficiently.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy balancing multiple priorities while working with people across the business, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we attract and hire talent at Related.

In this role, you'll play an important part in delivering seamless hiring experience while supporting the day-to-day operations of our recruiting function. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and internal business partners to coordinate interviews, manage pre-employment screening, facilitate onboarding, and ensure a smooth transition from candidate to new hire.

Beyond traditional recruiting coordination, this position also supports the business operations of Talent Acquisition, including job board advertising, staffing agency administration, vendor billing, expense tracking, and reporting.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in accuracy, and can balance multiple priorities while providing exceptional service. If you're someone who thrives on organization, enjoys working with people and data, and likes keeping processes running smoothly, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Responsibilties include:

**Recruiting Coordination and Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate interviews, manage scheduling logistics, and communicate with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Provide a welcoming and professional experience for candidates throughout the interview and hiring process.
* Prepare offer letters following internal approvals and monitor offer status through completion.
* Coordinate pre-employment background checks, track outstanding requirements, and communicate updates to recruiters and hiring managers.
* Partner with internal teams, including Legal, to facilitate background screening reviews and resolve outstanding issues.
* Maintain accurate candidate and hiring information in our applicant tracking system (iCIMS).

**New Hire Onboarding**

* Coordinate the onboarding process from offer acceptance through the employee's first day.
* Ensure new hires complete all required employment documents and preboarding requirements.
* Process new hire information through iCIMS and UKG, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Coordinate employment eligibility verification (Form I-9) in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers, IT, and training teams to ensure new hires are prepared for their first day.
* Communicate orientation schedules, first-day instructions, and onboarding details to new employees.
* Maintain accurate recruiting records and ensure filled requisitions are properly closed in iCIMS.

**Recruiting Operations and Vendor Management**

* Manage job postings across the company careers website and external job boards, including LinkedIn and Indeed.
* Monitor job board subscriptions, sponsored postings, advertising expenses, and renewal dates.
* Track job advertising performance and assist with evaluating recruiting sources and spending.
* Maintain staffing agency agreements, including placement fees, contract terms, and guarantee periods.
* Coordinate new and renewed staffing agency agreements with internal stakeholders.
* Verify agency candidate submissions and assist with resolving vendor-related questions.

**Billing, Reporting, and Administrative Support**

* Review, reconcile, and process recruiting-related invoices, including staffing agency fees, job board advertising, and other vendor expenses.
* Verify invoice accuracy and allocate expenses to the appropriate property, market, or cost center.
* Identify billing discrepancies and work with vendors to resolve issues.

* **Division/Department:** Visual & Performing Arts/Abrons Arts Center
* **Work Schedule:** Varies per week, Per Diem, Part Time
* **Pay Type:** $35/hour
* **Exemption Status:** Non-Exempt

  

**Organizational Overview:**

Henry Street Settlement opens doors of opportunity to enrich lives and expand human progress for Lower East Side residents and other New Yorkers through social services, arts, and health care programs. Building on its 125+ year legacy of innovation and effective programming, Henry Street offers more than 50 programs and is one of New York City’s largest social service agencies.

Abrons Arts Center is the home for artistic expression at Henry Street Settlement. It was founded in 1975 as the Arts for Living Center, adjacent to the historic Neighborhood Playhouse — an anchor of arts on the Lower East Side since 1915. Abrons Arts Center is the only comprehensive arts and culture center in New York City embedded within a social services agency.

  

**Program Overview:**

The Abrons production team supports the development and execution of the wide variety of multi-disciplinary works and multi-generational events that take place in our three theaters, two galleries, and outdoor amphitheater. We provide technical support for both in-house programming (resident artists’ performances, arts education showcases, Henry Street community events, etc.) and events and performances brought in by outside individuals and institutions renting one of our theatrical spaces.

Production crews can consist of audio, lighting, and A/V technicians, carpenters, scenic painters, stage managers, wardrobe supervisors, and deckhands for general production support during rehearsals and performances. Production Assistants are experienced technicians in their specific field(s) who are able to support designers and Production Leads in the execution of technical elements safely and seamlessly. Assistants may find themselves working as an A2/deckhand for live performances, providing hands-on, onstage support to the A1 at the mixer; using what’s on hand in our woodshop to do a lite carpentry project; providing wardrobe organization for a costume designer; operating a followspot while the lighting designer mans the board, etc. Production staff must be communicative and adaptable, ready to troubleshoot technical issues at a moment’s notice and convey technical aspects to non-technicians. In order to maintain production schedules, spaces, and equipment, we ask that production staff prioritize timeliness, cleanliness, safety as well.

Abrons crew as a whole are responsible for the proper restoration of theaters after their use, and should adhere to Abrons production protocols and duties as outlined by the Abrons production staff, even as they are supporting rental events.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Willingness to develop technical theater knowledge
* Willingness to get dirty and problem solve
* Experience working with all ages and experience levels in live events
* Must be able to take on all days of multi-day projects
* Must be a clear and consistent communicator

  

**Responsibilities:**

As determined each day by the Production Department, but inclusive of:

* Participating in and maintaining a safe working environment for all people on and off stage.
* Assisting fellow Production Leads, Assistants, Technicians, and Designers in their duties.
* Maintaining knowledge and skill sets between work calls.

  

**Essential Physical Job Functions:**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 25lbs.
* Must be able to easily navigate stairs and ladders, stand for up to four hours, and remain mobile in our large venue.
* Must be able to comprehend both written and verbal instructions in English.

* Experience with biologics, regenerative medicine, phlebotomy, laboratory procedures, or orthopedic healthcare preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, customer service, and program coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and electronic medical record systems.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but may provide training, education, and workflow guidance to clinical staff participating in biologics program activities.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

* BLS Certification required.
* RN, LPN, Certified Lab Technician, Certified Phlebotomist, or related clinical credential preferred.

Regular standing, walking, lifting, patient interaction, laboratory activities, and clinical procedure support are required. **Operations Specialist- Touring**

**MISSION**

Collaborate with internal teams, cruise line partners, and third-party vendors to plan, advance, and execute operational components of Sixthman events, delivering exceptional guest and talent experiences while ensuring operational excellence and successful event outcomes.

  

**DESCRIPTORS**

Liaise, Collaborate, Proactive, Organize, Plan, Track, Communicate

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Event Responsibilities**

* Build out and advance all operational details for 4-6 events per year, including event schedules, minute-by-minute action plans by department, and all activity information, from run of show to supplies and staffing schedules
* Serve as the primary operational liaison with third-party Producers to coordinate complex activities and ensure alignment between talent, vendors, and internal teams.
* Represent Operations during the event development phase alongside Event Managers, Community Experience Specialists, Procurement & Logistics, Production, and Talent Relations. Research the promises made to the guests/client/partner, assess feasibility, and proactively offer alternative creative solutions
* Manage the 12-month cycle of each event calendar in order to meet all cruise line (and resorts where needed) deadlines (120, 90, 60, 45, 30-day) so we meet or exceed all milestones for design, sponsors, F&B, activities, etc.
* Act as primary operational contact for activations such as Sponsorship or Charity
* Coordinate needs of Auxiliary Talent (including Tattoo, Face Painting, etc.) to ensure each team is provided the necessary support pre- and during the event. Recommend updates to the standard procedures, to continually improve and streamline
* Organize all aspects of event staffing including defining roles, scheduling, training and communicating with 50+ contract staff to optimize skill sets across multiple activities Lead advance meetings with ship leadership teams to communicate and discuss all event details to ensure understanding
* Additional projects and duties as assigned

  

**Department Responsibilities**

* Keep up to date and follow all cruise line and internal Sixthman policies and procedures and make recommendations as needed
* Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned shoreside departments, coordinating event requirements, communicating operational needs, and ensuring timely resolution of planning and execution-related projects (For example, Onboard Revenue departments)
* Coordinate the development, compilation, and distribution of operational documentation and timelines for third-party stakeholders, ship management teams, and port terminal partners to support successful event execution
* Contribute to seasonal operational planning efforts by identifying recurring challenges, recommending process improvements, and helping optimize staffing, logistics, and resource utilization across multiple events
* Update and maintain Tour Manager documents including the global memo, business rules, room reassignments, and furniture moves as assigned by Operations Manager
* Multi-task to run concurrent projects and prioritize and optimize overall workflow, knowing that each event will be in a different stage of lifecycle
* Collaborate with all arms of Operations on planning specifics for back-to-back charter seasons on simultaneous vessels. Responsible for sharing best practices and implementing recommendations with event teams
* Assist in the building and maintenance of training tools for the Tour Managers and Operations Team with the Operations Manager

  

**Sailing Responsibilities**

* Manage the overall execution of the event by collaborating closely with the event team and ship’s leadership
* Monitor the execution of all event activities, venues, shows, and hotel operations to address and troubleshoot any issues as they arise. Act as an onsite conduit to maintain open communication and collaboration to manage event adjustments in real time
* Lead multiple onboard meetings both with internal teams and shipboard leadership
* Coordinate with Logistics and participate in associated loading meetings. Oversee onboard inventory pack-up
* Oversee team of seasonally contracted PAs and Event Safety teams. Provide day-to-day leadership and operational direction to maintain an aligned, well-informed workforce
* Attend several of the Company’s events annually, and perform various duties onsite which could include Tour Manager, Tour Manager Assist, Activities Manager, or as the point person on a special activation (Meet & Greet, Charity Dinner, etc.)

  

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree required (or equivalent experience)
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
* Experience in event planning preferred
* Must have strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to coordinate and direct contract staff in a fast-paced event environment
* Good organization and delegation skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changes or challenges
* Problem-solving and critical thinking
* Detail-oriented with high accuracy
* Computer proficiency required and experience in project management software such as Monday.com preferred

  

**DISCUSSIONS YOU LEAD**

Facilitates operational planning discussions with cruise line shoreside departments, shipboard leadership, production partners, and internal teams. Drives alignment on event requirements, operational readiness, timeline management, and issue resolution to support successful event execution.

  

**WHO LEADS YOU**

Supervisor of Operations
