jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Splitit**

Our vision is to help consumers responsibly enrich their lives by leveraging the credit they've already earned in a new and impactful way. Today consumers want control of how they pay for the things they want and need. Splitit is the only payment platform that enables consumers to use their existing credit to break payments into smaller, bite-sized pieces to pay over time with no interest, applications, or fees. That keeps money in the hands of shoppers to use as they want. By helping shoppers pay small we help businesses grow big. That's a win-win. Splitit operates globally and has offices in Atlanta, New York, and Tel Aviv.

**Who We Are**

Our culture is an environment of innovation, inspiration, and open communication. We live by the following values: **Unique Perspective. Unwavering Courage. Bold Determination. Deliver Impact.** Our values aren't words we post on the wall, they make up the essence of who we are and how we make business decisions. They also shape the way we hire, so if you work with us, you will likely embody these too.

**What You'll Do**

The Marketing Coordinator keeps Splitit's brand visible and its marketing engine running day to day. Reporting to the Head of Marketing and based in our Atlanta office, this role owns social media, event planning and execution, and collateral creation, with some additional support on swag and office supply ordering. This is a hands-on, in-person role for someone who thrives on variety, moves fast, and sweats the details.

* Own Splitit's social media presence end to end: content calendar, posting, community engagement, and performance tracking across channels
* Plan and execute events, both internal (team offsites, all-hands, celebrations) and external (conferences, trade shows, sponsorships, client events), managing logistics, vendors, budgets, and on-site execution
* Build marketing collateral including sales decks, one-pagers, case studies, and templates, keeping everything on-brand and ready for the field
* Order and manage swag for events, new hires, and client gifting, and handle select office supply ordering for the Atlanta office
* Partner closely with Sales and the Head of Marketing to make sure events and collateral support pipeline and brand goals
* Learn new tools and processes quickly as Splitit's marketing function scales

  

**Who You Are**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in marketing, events, or a related field, with hands-on experience planning and executing events from start to finish
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Creative instincts and an eye for design and brand consistency across social, collateral, and event materials
* A fast learner who is energized, not overwhelmed, by a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable with social media platforms and scheduling tools; familiarity with design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) a plus
* Able to work primarily in person from Splitit's Atlanta office

**At Splitit, we understand that we're strongest when we can be different together.** Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are not just about metrics for us. It's about creating space for all individuals who walk through our doors, employee or not, to bring their full selves to the table. We strive to build teams as diverse as our markets and celebrate differences in background and perspective.

Splitit is an equal opportunity employer, meaning all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. **HealthPlanOne's mission is to help people find the right health insurance at the right price, so they live healthier lives. We are committed to making the shopping process simpler. Our mission has never been more important than it is today.**

The Associate Account Manager will assist in the development, expansion, and maintenance of HPOne’s client relationships to achieve customer retention and growth. They will serve as the client advocate and advisor for small and medium size clients and assist Director with large enterprise clients, deepening customer relationships through meaningful interactions.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Ensure effective facilitation, coordination, development, implementation, and execution of the small and medium client programs.
* Assist effective facilitation, coordination, development, implementation, and execution of the large client programs.
* Provide consultative support to assist clients in meeting business goals.
* Manage coordination, monitoring and tracking of deliverables to ensure service delivery of key client and HPOne success factors.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with clients and all internal departments to deliver service as outlined in the program objectives.
* Offer solutions to enhance client performance and expand the services for small and medium clients provided by HPOne.
* Conduct regular internal operational meetings to review performance.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the entire call center operation as well as project operation.
* Manage change management process for assigned client.
* Resolve conflicts and provide solutions to his/her clients in a timely manner and provide support and assistance to the Director in these areas.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business or relevant concentration
* 1 year of experience in a call center or client services role
* Ability to solve complex problems in a customer-facing role
* Discipline and organization to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong relationship management skills, both internally and externally
* Ability to understand customer data and make recommendations to operations/client based on analytics
* Excellent verbal, written and Microsoft Outlook skills
* Experience in creating and presenting customer presentations
* High level of integrity, judgment and follow through
* Strong attention to detail

**Preferred Skills/Abilities:**

* Experience in a business-to-business customer environment with health plans or within healthcare

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position (e.g., sitting or standing) for extended periods of time, typically in a cubicle environment (constant noise, fluorescent overhead lighting)
* Frequent use of a computer, dual monitors, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment such as a telephone, copier, and printer.
* Must be able to communicate effectively, including exchanging information in person, in writing, by telephone, email or video conferencing.
* Visual and auditory acuity required to perform job duties effectively, including reading, writing, and interpreting information on screens or in print.
* Hand dexterity, fine motor skills needed to operate a keyboard and mouse efficiently
* Reach with hands and arms occasionally

**For Hybrid Roles:**

* Must be able to commute to an office setting as required, which may include walking short distances and navigating an office environment.
* Occasionally moves about the office to access files, office machinery, and meet with others.
* Ability to travel 10%

**Compensation and Benefits:**
==============================

  
We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your health and wellbeing including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with employer match. The compensation range for this position is $59,400.00 - $73,200.00. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including education, training, experience, business needs, and work location.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) is a fundamental principle at HealthPlanOne, where employment is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications. HealthPlanOne does not discriminate because of actual or perceived sex, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, gender, transgender, race, color, religion, national origin, creed, citizenship status, ancestry, age, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, medical conditions including genetic characteristics, mental or physical disability, military and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as established by law. HealthPlanOne requires the necessary drug testing and background checks as part of our pre-employment practices. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us to request accommodation at hr@hpone.com**

jobs.title: Regional Commercial Sales Account Manager- Philadelphia
jobs.description:
**Purpose:**  
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is responsible for outside commercial sales, lead generation, client procurement, and commercial job management. This primary role is outside sales of Floor & Decor’s Commercial products to medium and large institutional buyers. In addition to working on leads sourced at the store level you will also act as a liaison with the Inside Commercial Sales team and the end-user customer. In addition, this person will work with the Commercial Support Center to source, bid, and administer large commercial jobs.

Specific responsibilities include daily sales calls on existing customers. Will be required to present products to such entities as builders, developers, designers, contractors and all other decision makers in the sales and installation process. Additionally, must continually prospect for viable new accounts while developing a key awareness of what is happening within the (local) market.

**Minimum Eligibility Requirements:**

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent - Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3+ years previous commercial industry sales experience required (preferably within the flooring or building materials industry)
* Successful track record in an outside sales environment
* Candidate must have familiarity with the LOCAL market
* Must be competent to work with and manage customer base thru CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tool such as Salesforce.com
* Experience required in RFPs, commercial job bids, and general construction sales
* Experience working in a retail environment a plus
* Strong analytical skills and problem-solving
* Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills including influencing and negotiation skills
* Ability to multi-task, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment
* A proven ability to work in an unstructured, unsupervised environment is required and must be able to exercise independent judgment and demonstrate solid time management and organizational skills
* Enjoy prospecting for new accounts

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Travel daily throughout the assigned area to call on existing customers and prospect new customers to solicit business
* Manage projects from inception to completion including identifying opportunity, product selection, specification, order placement, order tracking, delivery coordination, installation oversight, punch walk, and claim coordination (if necessary)
* Must continually prospect for viable new accounts while developing an awareness of what is happening within their local market
* Follow up on a variety of leads from sources such as Dodge, store leads, networking groups, etc.
* Work with the PRO Teams in each location to pursue commercial leads passed along by the store team to maximize sales efforts
* Submit proposals and responses to RFQs and RFPs issued by prospective customers after obtaining pricing and specifications approval from management, as appropriate
* Follow-up with the Inside Commercial Sales team on key dates to complete sales and satisfy the customer’s requirements
* Work with the purchasing and inventory teams via the Commercial Support Center to confirm product availability or if a special purchase order (PO) is needed
* Stay current on merchandise training, new products and product lines
* Monitor prospects’ contract calendars and prepare reports on status of leads and other reports as required
* Participate in trade associations and trade shows, and assists in other promotional efforts
* Perform additional functions, duties and specific tasks of a similar nature and scope as necessary in order to achieve assigned business objectives

**Working Conditions (travel and environment)**

* Daily car travel with limited air travel based upon customer and/or corporate events
* The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet to moderate

**Benefits & Rewards**

Bonus opportunities & career advancement opportunities at every level

Programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Referral Bonus Program

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria)

Work-life balance, including:

* Paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates
* Paid holidays plus a personal holiday
* Paid Volunteer Time Off that starts on Day 1

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Floor & Decor provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other category protected by law.

This policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, testing, screening, hiring, selection for training, upgrading, transfer, demotion, layoff, discipline, termination, compensation, benefits and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. This policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any associate or applicant on the basis of any legally protected status outlined above.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Empowering Connections, Inspiring Possibility

SageNet is a leading managed services provider specializing in connectivity, digital signage, and cybersecurity. Headquartered in Tulsa, OK, with regional offices across the U.S., SageNet connects, manages, and protects technologies and devices across widely distributed enterprises, serving customers in industries such as retail, finance, healthcare, utilities, and energy.

SageNet’s nationwide infrastructure includes 24/7/365 U.S.-based Network and Security Operations Centers, geographically diverse teleports, multiple data centers, a national logistics center, and a nationwide field services organization. The company manages communications for more than 430,000 endpoints across the country.

What makes SageNet unique is its Why: a passion for Trusted Connections. This is a two-fold commitment. First, SageNet delivers secure, reliable, and innovative technological connections for its customers. Second, and just as importantly, the company works tirelessly to build trusted human connections with its customers, partners, and communities. By creating and nurturing these trusted connections, SageNet enhances the world that connects us all.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As a Customer Success Manager, Satellite Services, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for customers throughout their relationship with SageNet. You will help coordinate customer needs from initial conversations and quoting through contracting, implementation, ongoing service, renewals, and account growth.

In addition to supporting the ongoing success of your customer portfolio, you'll help coordinate quotes, contracts, renewals, implementation activities, and service changes while identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships and deliver additional value.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping customers, keeping details organized, and working across teams to ensure commitments are fulfilled. You will support existing customer accounts, assist with qualified opportunities provided by SageNet, and help customers receive continued value from their satellite services. Deep satellite knowledge is not required on day one. We are looking for someone who is curious, conscientious, relationship-focused, and excited to learn.

***Major Duties and Responsibilities***

**Customer Relationships & Success**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned Satellite Services customers, building trusted relationships and delivering an exceptional customer experience.
* Support customers throughout onboarding, implementation, ongoing service, renewals, and account growth.
* Maintain regular communication with customers to understand their business needs, answer questions, and ensure they receive maximum value from SageNet's services.
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Service Delivery, Finance, and Support to coordinate customer requests, resolve issues, and ensure successful service delivery.
* Conduct regular customer check ins and gather feedback to strengthen relationships and identify opportunities for improvement.

***Account Coordinator & Growth***

* Support existing customer accounts and qualified opportunities by coordinating quotes, proposals, statements of work, contracts, purchase orders, and renewals.
* Track implementations, service changes, and customer requests to ensure projects are completed accurately and on time.
* Identify opportunities to expand customer relationships through additional services and solutions that align with customer needs.
* Maintain accurate customer information, account activity, and opportunities within Salesforce and other SageNet systems.
* Continuously learn SageNet's satellite solutions, processes, and systems while looking for ways to improve the customer experience.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

Success in this role is measured by the quality of the customer experience, the accuracy and timeliness of account coordination, and your ability to strengthen and grow customer relationships.

You will be successful when you:

* Build trusted and responsive relationships with customers.
* Keep customers informed throughout quoting, contracting, implementation, and ongoing service.
* Coordinate effectively across departments to ensure customer commitments are fulfilled accurately and on time.
* Support customer retention and identify appropriate opportunities for account growth.
* Deliver a positive customer experience by communicating proactively and following through on commitments.
* Take ownership of your work while continuously learning SageNet's products, services, and processes.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You enjoy building relationships and helping customers succeed. You're organized, curious, and proactive, with a customer first mindset and a willingness to learn. You communicate naturally, take ownership of your work, and enjoy collaborating with others to solve problems and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We're not looking for someone who already knows everything about satellite technology. We're looking for someone who is eager to learn, enjoys working with customers, and wants to build a long-term career with SageNet.

***Required Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0 to 5 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, account coordination, sales support, client services, customer service, business development, or another customer-facing role. Recent graduates with relevant internships, coursework, or transferable experience are encouraged to apply
* Strong customer service, communication, and relationship-building skills
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver exceptional customer service
* Demonstrated initiative, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies and busine

* Actively search for solutions to problems

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

**About Protomiq**

At Protomiq, we believe that the auto dealerships that win are the ones that create better experiences for their customers. That's why we build technology that helps dealers connect with shoppers, turn interest into action, and drive measurable business results.

More than 6,000 dealerships across North America rely on Protomiq's solutions to engage customers, improve performance, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market.

From independent dealerships to some of the largest dealer groups and automotive brands in the industry, Protomiq is trusted by dealerships focused on what comes next.

If you're excited by innovation, customer impact, and the opportunity to help shape the future of automotive retail, you'll fit right in.

**Working at Protomiq**

At Protomiq, your work matters. We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who are passionate about helping our customers succeed. Here, you'll be empowered to move quickly, embrace new ideas, and make a visible impact on the business.

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a culture built on collaboration, accountability, and growth.

**The Role**

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the voice of the dealer inside Protomiq and the trusted partner they turn to long after go-live. Your core mission is retention, and you earn it by understanding what each customer is trying to achieve, building a strategy to get there, and proving the value of Protomiq along the way.

You'll regularly engage at both the group and dealership level, building relationships with dealer principals, GMs, marketing directors, and Variable and Fixed Ops Directors. You'll lead performance reviews and connect the metrics that matter to each dealership's business objectives.

This is a hybrid role based out of our Atlanta office in the Dunwoody area. Our team works in the office four days a week with one flexible remote day, a rhythm that keeps collaboration strong and gives you real access to teammates, leaders, and the support to grow. During your first month, you'll be in the office five days a week as you complete a structured onboarding and training program designed to set you up for success.

**Why this role**

* Be the trusted advisor, not just a support contact
* Own retention and expansion outcomes for your book, with clear visibility into how your work moves the numbers
* Work with a full suite of shopper intelligence products that help dealers turn website activity into closed deals
* Join a growing automotive SaaS team where new ideas are welcomed and your input shapes our playbooks

**What you'll do**

* **Advocate for our customers:** Represent the dealer's goals and needs internally, and work across Sales, Onboarding, Product, and Support to close the loop
* **Build strategy:** Partner with dealer groups and dealerships to define success and create a plan to achieve it
* **Communicate the value:** Lead strategy reviews, QBRs, and training that tie product results to dealer objectives and demonstrate ROI
* **Protect and grow the relationship:** Monitor account health, address risks early, and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities that fit each customer's goals
* **Strengthen our playbooks:** Stay current on the automotive industry and our products, and help shape CSM best practices
* **Travel as needed:** Up to 10% for internal meetings, training, events or dealership visits

Requirements:

* 1+ year of automotive software (SaaS) experience OR experience in a dealership role using automotive software (digital retail, CRM, desking, etc.), with a solid understanding of automotive retail
* Proven success managing diverse accounts as a Customer Success Manager or in a similar role
* Experience with CRMs
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills
* Comfort with data-driven decision-making and optimizing metrics
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Quick thinking and flexibility, with the drive, grit, and goal-minded motivation to keep learning and keep winning in a growing organization
* A positive, customer-centric mindset and the ability to work both independently and across teams

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to AI products and automation strategies, and a curiosity and willingness to explore how AI can improve the way we work and serve customers
* Salesforce experience
* Basic understanding of Google Analytics (GA4)
* Basic understanding of digital marketing strategies

jobs.title: Customer Success Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Pringle Robotics is expanding to multiple new metros and is looking for motivated and hardworking individuals who want to be on the cutting edge of robotic technology. We are looking for experienced equipment repair technicians who want to build a business from the ground up. The right candidate will be eager to learn how to service, repair, and deploy our robotic cleaning, and wants to be a key team member who will be here for the long term. The position requires independence, strong communication and customer service skills, and a desire to provide excellent service to build a strong brand.

The Customer Success Technician (CST) will be responsible for becoming the company expert on the installation, use, and maintenance of our autonomous robots. The CST will work with our Sales Managers and Customer Service Specialists to ensure the successful deployment and repair of our robotic solutions. The CST will work with customers to understand their needs and configure the robots to meet these needs best. You will be the front line for the operational side of the business, and be expected to build positive customer relationships based on excellent service.

**About Us:** Pringle Robotics creates and sells the most advanced autonomous robots for hosting, delivery, and sanitation tasks on the market. We are on the cutting edge of technology and positioned for substantial growth over the next few years. This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing industries with a great company on the ground floor. The opportunity for growth and advancement for motivated and hard-working individuals is unlimited.

**Employee Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Installs, programs, maintains, and repairs robots and related equipment, like programmable controllers, robot controllers, and components, applying knowledge of electronics, electrical circuits, mechanics, pneumatics, hydraulics, and programming, using power tools, hand tools, and testing instruments following manuals, schematic diagrams, and blueprints.
* Reviews work orders and related manuals, blueprints, and schematic diagrams to define tasks to be performed tools, equipment, and parts needed for installation of repair assignment.
* Program robot to perform specific tasks, applying knowledge of programming language, using a computer or control panel on the robot.
* Work with customers to learn their specific needs for robots, and implement solutions for those needs.
* Train customers on the use of robots, troubleshooting, and other related tasks.
* Maintenance of company office, warehouse, vehicle, and tools.
* Represent the company and communicate with customers in a professional manner.

**Education, Experience, and Licensing Requirements:**

* At least three (2) years of field repair and installation work, preferably in an equipment or technology-related industry
* Great troubleshooting skills and ability to work under pressure
* Ability and desire to learn new technologies and hardware quickly and thoroughly
* Availability on weekends for occasional on-call support
* Great customer service skills
* Have a current, valid driver's license and a clean driving record
* Occasional overnight travel to remote customer sites (up to 10-20%)
* Significant local travel.(80-90%)
* Ability to lift 80 lbs.
* Valid Driver’s License

Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

* 75% (Required)

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at PowerPlan, you will manage the relationship of a portfolio of energy and utility customers, serving as their trusted advisor from renewal to expansion. You will partner with Sales and the extended account team to help each customer get measurable ROI from their PowerPlan solutions, working proactively to keep your accounts healthy, surface opportunities and address risk before it becomes churn, and grow ARR year over year.

You will work at every level of a customer's organization, building trusted relationships and staying connected across the account, including leading quarterly business reviews to senior leadership. This is a relationship-driven, customer-facing role where retention, advocacy, and growth are yours to drive.

PowerPlan is the leading tax and accounting software for asset-intensive businesses, improving financial outcomes through AI-powered technology that enables companies to overcome their most complex financial challenges. Our enterprise-grade tax, accounting, reporting, and workflow automation software serves the office of the CFO at some of the world's largest asset-intensive companies, helping them generate more cashflow, mitigate compliance risk, and build a culture of cost management.

Our Customer Success organization is where that promise is kept after the sale: the team that turns PowerPlan's capabilities into renewals, references, and long-term value for our customers.

Responsibilities:

* Own the renewal and forecast outcome for your assigned book of business, understanding each account's contractual terms, pricing strategy, and services history to track ARR, churn risk, and bringing accurate status into the monthly Renewal and Risk Meeting.
* Become a trusted advisor by building multithreaded relationships across each account, removing roadblocks and demonstrating a clear return on their PowerPlan investment.
* Build industry acumen in Energy, Utilities, and other asset-intensive industries, and maintain functional knowledge of the PowerPlan solution, understanding what drives customer success, speaking credibly to product capabilities, and knowing each customer's product footprint and usage, so you can anticipate needs and guide accounts toward the outcomes that matter most to them.
* Maintain strong customer sentiment and account engagement through proactive relationship management, accurate health scoring in Salesforce and Planhat, early risk identification, and save plans that drive net-positive red-to-green movement each quarter.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews that connect PowerPlan capabilities to customer business objectives, demonstrate value through utilization and outcome metrics, identify opportunities to increase adoption, and align on desired outcomes, agreed-upon next steps, and a path to long-term value realization.
* Manage the NPS survey for your customers, driving survey participation, closing the loop on feedback with each respondent, and helping the team reach its best-in-class score and response-rate targets.
* Represent the voice of the customer, translating feedback, business needs, and product usage trends into actionable insights for Product and Marketing to improve customer outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to year-over-year growth by identifying expansion opportunities, generating qualified leads for Sales, and developing referenceable customers.
* Advocate for your customer needs cross-functionally, coordinating with Sales, Support and Professional Services to resolve escalations, define action plans and achieve account objectives.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Account Management, Enterprise Software, SaaS, Professional Services, or a related field.
* Proven success managing a portfolio of customer relationships with accountability for customer retention, renewal outcomes, adoption, and growth opportunities.
* Experience building trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at every level, from senior leadership to day-to-day users.
* Experience using Salesforce, Gainsight, Planhat, or a comparable Customer Success platform strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and proactively drive customer outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels within customer organizations and internally across cross-functional teams.
* Experience leading customer business reviews, developing success plans, and driving customer engagement initiatives that deliver measurable business value.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate complex customer environments, and coordinate efforts across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, and other internal teams.
* Familiarity with AI-driven technologies and customer-facing software solutions is a plus, as PowerPlan continues to expand AI-powered capabilities across the NXT SaaS platform.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and energized by working both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Willingness to travel to support customer engagements, business reviews, onsite meetings, and strategic account planning.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

**PowerPlan is an EOE**

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

* Proven ability to work independently and take initiative with minimal supervision.

* Apply campaign links supplied by the Digital Search and Analytics Manager and assist with routine reporting inputs and content updates informed by performance findings.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of relevant experience; internships and strong project work.
* Familiarity with WordPress or another CMS, social publishing, and Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable design tools.

* Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; work samples demonstrating content and basic design skills.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to President / Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Chicago and surrounding suburbs (currently Buffalo Grove)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with occasional evenings or weekends as business needs require  
**Reports To:** President / Owner  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience

About the Position

We are seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to work directly with the President and Owner of a diverse portfolio of businesses in the Chicago area.

Our businesses span the restaurant, bakery, retail, hospitality, entertainment, and consulting industries.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur overseeing multiple growing companies, including Hello Kitty Café Chicago, Hello Tokyo, Good Fortune Baking, and other hospitality and retail ventures.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**This is not a traditional administrative assistant position.** We are looking for a trusted right-hand person who can help coordinate day-to-day business activities, oversee follow-ups, manage special projects, and ensure that important responsibilities are completed efficiently.

Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive & Personal Assistance

* Manage the President's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.
* Organize and prioritize emails, correspondence, and communications.
* Coordinate business and personal travel arrangements.
* Prepare documents, presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and correspondence.
* Maintain confidential business and personal records.
* Assist with personal appointments, errands, and logistical arrangements as needed.

Business Operations Coordination

* Serve as a central point of communication between the President, managers, employees, vendors, and business partners.
* Follow up with management teams regarding assigned tasks, deadlines, and operational issues.
* Track outstanding projects and ensure timely completion.
* Help identify operational problems and coordinate solutions.
* Assist with employee onboarding, scheduling coordination, and administrative HR matters.
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants, attorneys, and outside consultants.
* Visit business locations as necessary to check on projects and report progress.

Vendor & Project Management

* Communicate with suppliers, contractors, landlords, and service providers.
* Request quotes, compare pricing, and coordinate purchasing.
* Track vendor orders, deliveries, invoices, and outstanding issues.
* Coordinate maintenance, repairs, installations, and renovations.
* Manage project timelines and provide regular progress updates.
* Research products, services, and business opportunities.

Financial & Administrative Support

* Organize invoices, receipts, contracts, and financial documents.
* Monitor upcoming payments, renewals, and administrative deadlines.
* Assist with expense tracking, invoice verification, and basic reporting.
* Prepare business performance summaries using information from managers and existing systems.
* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting teams.
* Maintain organized digital files and records across multiple companies.

Marketing & Special Projects

* Assist with coordinating marketing initiatives, promotions, and special events.
* Communicate with marketing agencies, designers, and outside partners.
* Help organize private events, business meetings, and promotional activities.
* Research new business concepts, potential vendors, and expansion opportunities.
* Support new business openings and other special projects assigned by the President.

Qualifications

* Minimum 3 years of experience in executive assistance, business administration, operations coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience supporting a business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive strongly preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple companies, projects, and competing deadlines.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and independent judgment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and modern business software.
* Comfortable learning new technology, including AI productivity tools.
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel between Chicago-area business locations.
* Hospitality, restaurant, or retail experience is a plus, but not required.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* **Takes ownership:** Doesn't wait to be told every step and follows tasks through to completion.
* **Is exceptionally organized:** Keeps track of deadlines, responsibilities, and details across multiple businesses.
* **Is resourceful:** Can research problems, identify solutions, and present recommendations.
* **Communicates effectively:** Provides concise updates and knows when an issue requires the President's attention.
* **Is adaptable:** Comfortable switching between executive support, business operations, and personal assistance.
* **Is trustworthy:** Handles confidential business, financial, and personal matters with discretion.
* **Gets things done:** Focuses on execution, accountability, and results.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will have established an organized system for managing the President's schedule, communications, business priorities, and outstanding projects.

**About Pocas International Corp.**

At Pocas International Corp., we are a passionate importer and distributor focused on bringing unique, high-quality specialty products from around the world to customers and partners throughout the United States and beyond.

Since 2005, we have built strong, long-term relationships with distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and business partners by offering exceptional products and service with honesty, integrity, and consistency.

As part of our continued business expansion, we are also growing our K-beauty, cosmetics, and related lifestyle product lines alongside our established food & beverage business, working across a multi-branch network in New Jersey, California, Illinois, Texas, Georgia, and Florida.

Kindly visit www.pocas.com for details!

**Position Summary**

Pocas International Corp. is seeking a **B2B Sales Representative** to grow and manage accounts across our wholesale and retail distribution network. This is a field-first, business-to-business sales role — the successful candidate will spend the majority of their time visiting existing customers to maintain and grow the relationship, and cold calling/prospecting new accounts within the assigned territory.

Primary target channels include Beauty Supply stores, Beauty & Health wholesalers, general wholesale distributors, chain supermarkets, retail chains, and independent markets. Experience selling into the Beauty Supply channel or Beauty-related B2B accounts is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong B2B wholesale/retail sales experience in any consumer product category are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Existing Account Management**

Conduct regular in-person visits to existing wholesale, retail, and distributor accounts to maintain the relationship, review performance, and identify growth opportunities.

Present new products, promotions, and pricing programs to existing buyers and store owners.

Resolve account-level issues (order concerns, delivery timing, pricing questions) by coordinating with internal Operations and Customer Service teams.

Maintain a consistent visit cadence and account history for each assigned customer.

**New Business Development / Cold Calling**

Prospect and generate new accounts through outbound cold calling, in-person cold visits, trade shows, and industry events.

Identify and prioritize target accounts among Beauty Supply stores, Beauty & Health wholesalers, wholesale distributors, chain supermarkets, retail chains, and independent markets.

Present product lines, pricing, and promotional programs directly to buyers and decision-makers.

Negotiate initial orders, pricing, and promotional placement within company-approved guidelines.

Represent the company at trade shows and industry events to build the account pipeline.

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination**

Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, visit log, and account records using CRM or reporting tools.

Communicate order details and customer requirements to the internal operations/customer service team for processing — this role is not responsible for order fulfillment or inventory coordination.

Gather and share competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and market trends observed in the field with Sales, Purchasing, and Marketing.

Coordinate with branch teams via Microsoft Teams on account status, delivery timing, and customer needs.

**Qualifications**

Experience in B2B, wholesale, or retail account sales, with a track record of both managing existing accounts and developing new business through cold calling/prospecting.

Willingness and ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory to visit customers in person.

Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Strong in-person relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Comfortable making outbound cold calls and initiating contact with new prospective accounts.

Self-motivated and able to work independently in the field with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Strong follow-up discipline and accurate CRM/record-keeping habits.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience selling into the **Beauty Supply** channel, or other **Beauty & Health B2B** wholesale accounts.

Existing relationships with Beauty Supply stores, beauty/health wholesalers, chain supermarkets, retail chains, or independent markets.

Direct experience with K-beauty, cosmetics, skincare, or beauty and personal-care products.

Familiarity with beauty trends, product positioning, competitor research, and customer buying behavior.

Bilingual proficiency (English plus Spanish or Korean) is a plus, but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**

Existing accounts are retained and grown, with a reliable, professional visit cadence.

New account acquisition through cold calling and prospecting is consistent and on pace with territory goals.

The sales pipeline and account records are accurate and up to date.

Field feedback and market trends are captured and shared to support the broader business.

**Why Join Us**

Sell across an expanding portfolio spanning food & beverage and K-beauty/cosmetics into established Beauty Supply, wholesale, and retail channels.

Own your territory and customer relationships with significant day-to-day autonomy.

Focus on what you do best — selling — without being pulled into internal operations work.

Be part of a multicultural company with an established U.S. distribution network across NJ, CA, IL, TX, GA, and FL.

Better communication. Better customer experiences. Better workmanship. **Dad Standards™.**

We're looking for an ambitious, experienced salesperson who knows how to create opportunities, build relationships, and close business.

**This is not a position where you sit around waiting for leads.**

We're looking for someone who wants to get out in the field, meet homeowners, generate business, and take ownership of their results.

If you're a natural closer who enjoys the hunt, we'd like to meet you.

What You'll Do

* Prospect and generate new roofing opportunities throughout Chicago.
* Build relationships with homeowners, real estate professionals, property managers, and referral partners.
* Conduct initial customer consultations and identify roofing needs.
* Present estimates and proposals, overcome objections, and close deals.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and existing customers.
* Develop referral business and long-term customer relationships.
* Manage your opportunities and sales pipeline through our CRM.
* Coordinate with our production team to ensure a smooth customer handoff.
* Represent Dad Exteriors with professionalism, confidence, and integrity.

Who We're Looking For

* Proven experience in sales, preferably roofing, windows, siding, construction, or home improvement.
* A self-starter who doesn't need someone telling them what to do every morning.
* Comfortable prospecting, cold calling, networking, and generating their own leads.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Confident presenting and closing high-ticket projects.
* Organized, accountable, and comfortable using CRM software.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Someone who takes pride in the customer experience, not just getting the signature.

**Most importantly:** You have the drive to build your own pipeline and the discipline to follow through.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation with uncapped earning potential.
* An established local brand with a differentiated approach to roofing.
* Company-generated opportunities alongside your own prospecting efforts.
* Sales tools, estimating support, and production coordination.
* Opportunity to grow into a sales leadership role as the business expands.
* A founder-led company where performance gets noticed and rewarded.

Why Dad Exteriors?

We're not trying to be another roofing company chasing the lowest price.

Our customers hire us because they want confidence in the people working on their homes. We bring decades of construction experience, a professional process, and a commitment to doing things right.

We're building our sales team around people who share that mindset.

**If you can sell, prospect, and take ownership of your results, there's an opportunity here to build something meaningful.**

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer these three questions:

* What have you sold, and what were your approximate annual sales results?
* How do you generate new business when the company isn't providing leads?
* Why do you think you'd be successful selling roofing in Chicago?

**Dad Exteriors — Dad Standards™. No Shortcuts.**

Pay: $48,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60639

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**The Company**

**VINCI Construction Grands Projets USA** (formally VINCI Construction LLC) is a subsidiary of **VINCI Construction Grands Projets** with its main office located in Alexandria, Virginia. The scope of the company is general contracting and construction work, along with any associated services related to large, selected Design and Build projects, either public or private for which it can bring clear and strong added value. We aim to develop engineering and construction services for large infrastructure projects in various parts in the United States and provide a highly skilled and competitive professional service in construction field.

  

**Project Overview**

The Walsh-VINCI Transit Community Partners (WVTCP) Joint Venture consisting of VINCI Construction Grands Projets and Walsh Construction has been selected to construct the $2.9BN Design Build Red Line Extension (RLE) project – the largest civil construction contract ever awarded by the Chicago Transit Authority (CTA).

The RLE Mainline Design-Build (MDB) Project will extend the CTA's Red Line by 5.6 miles, extending from the existing terminal at 95th/Dan Ryan south to 130th Street and Doty Avenue.

Learn more about the RLE project at the **WVTCP-RLE website here!**

  

**Responsibilities:**

As an **Assistant Project Manager (Stations)**, you will oversee the safe and timely delivery of the new RLE stations. Your responsibilities will include planning, procurement, and construction oversight for the structural steel of the new elevated stations, as well as managing and coordinating the primary subcontractors responsible for station building works. You will work closely with teams involved in guideway, civil, track, and systems works to ensure effective interface management and project integration.

* Analyses scope of works on project drawings and project specifications and schedules works accordingly
* Prepares and manages procurement packages for self-delivered scope: technical coordination with suppliers, review of shop drawings, site delivery and installation management. This applies to the structural steel package for the platforms in particular
* Prepares construction documentation (work plans, specification submittals, means and methods drawings) for scope activities
* Briefs construction teams on scope, means and methods, schedule and safety analysis for scope activities
* Coordinates with other project teams to ensure interfaces are being managed to avoid project delays. In particular: drives coordination for site preparation activities, manages interface with utilities connections, manages interface with guideway and track installation works, manages interface with civil works around stations
* Coordinates activities between subcontractors to drive schedule and maintain a safe working environment
* Reviews and tracks subcontractor’s documentation (construction submittals, schedules, progress reports, quality documentation)
* Prepares and updates schedule for scope construction, tracks project progress and identifies trends to report on variations and identify solutions
* Cost control for self-delivered activities
* Progress control for subcontracted activities
* Drives and monitors quality documentation completion
* Meets with project crews on a daily basis to review production means, schedule, safety, and to resolve field issues
* Reviews crew timecards
* Manages RFIs and NCRs, in collaboration with field, design and quality teams
* Maintains site records with project engineers
* Maintains a log of quality deliverables with project engineers and quality team
* Records main project quantities, productivities, and lessons learned to feed into JV’s return of experience report
* Performs other related duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications and Skills:**

***Required:***

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 5 years of construction engineering experience on contractor’s side on building or **heavy civil construction** projects.
* Experience with developing means and methods for construction activities.
* Experience with cost control on self-delivered construction scope.
* Experience with scheduling construction works, using common softwares such as Primavera, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Familiar with CAD tools for construction planning purposes (means and methods): site layouts, lift plans.
* Experience analyzing technical documents, including design drawings and specification
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills for a large construction project
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and to adapt to a fast paced construction project environment
* Knowledge of relevant safety and environmental regulations and best practices.
* Ability to assume responsibility, interface and communicate effectively with others
* Fluent in English
* Valid divers' license

  

***Preferred***

* Prior experience working with steel structure
* Prior experience working on multi-disciplinary buildings with multiple interfaces
* Prior experience with mass transit projects

  

**Salary Range:**

* $109,250.00 - $132,250.00

  

**Work Environment:**

* Involves a dynamic and challenging work environment.
* Work in environmental extremes of heat and cold, dependent upon job location.
* Fast-paced environment that may require long hours, including nights and weekends.
* Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, and reflective vests when on-site.
* Required to drive to construction

  

**Physical Demands:**

* Must be able to lift 25lbs.
* Occasional bending, stooping, twisting, crawling, kneeling.
* Occasional climbing of ladders.
* Frequent work in dusty environments.
* Frequent work in areas of excessive noise.
* Work variable hours, including overtime hours as needed.

**Reports to:** Operations Department

**Wages:** $19.00 - $26.00 Hourly \*Actual wages are based upon level of education and or experience\*

**Position Summary:**

The Part-Time **Program Specialist I, II, III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one-on-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of support, progress, and services.

Some key responsibilities of this role are providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines; promoting independent living skills; and supporting with Community Integration and Employment Goals. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to fit each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence.

You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma-informed, person-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step-by-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

You will create and facilitate accessible virtual activities that encourage social connection, engagement, and community participation, while providing continuity and support when individuals transition to in-person programming.

* **Collaborate with on-site staff, job coaches, and program coordinators to coordinate seamless service delivery.**

You will communicate updates, share documentation, and collaborate with team members to maintain consistency in support plans and services. Bilingual communication may also help strengthen coordination with Spanish-speaking families.

* **Set measurable weekly and monthly objectives to help individuals build communication, life, educational, and employment skills.**

You will help individuals establish achievable goals related to communication, daily living, education, employment, and personal development. Progress will be monitored and goals adjusted as needed, with support provided in the individual's preferred language when appropriate.

* **Track and document individual progress, support needs, and goals using internal agency systems.**

You will maintain accurate, timely, objective, and confidential records of individual progress, support needs, goals, observations, and follow-up requirements using agency systems.

* **Submit accurate monthly progress notes, service logs, and activity calendars in compliance with agency deadlines.**

You will complete and submit timely documentation reflecting sessions, training, coaching, educational support, and other services provided while following agency formats and deadlines.

The **Time Critical Logistics Coordinator** is responsible for facilitating domestic and international freight across air transportation modes. They are a key liaison between customers, carriers, customs authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure freight moves efficiently, compliantly, and cost effectively from origin to destination. They are highly organized, detail oriented, and capable of managing multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment. They play a critical role in delivering exceptional service while supporting operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic and international freight shipments across air transportation modes.

* Manage the end-to-end forwarding process from shipment initiation through final delivery.

* Own the complete shipment process in CargoWise, including data entry, pickup and delivery scheduling, AES entry, airline bookings, routing, operational milestone updates, and costing.

* Ensure all customers' SOP instructions are adhered to, and internal/company KPIs and guidelines are and met.

* Prepare, review, and process shipping documentation including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, and other transportation documents.

* Communicate proactively with customers, carriers, customs brokers, steamship lines, airlines, trucking providers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and requirements.

* Track and monitor freight movements to ensure timely pickup, transit, customs clearance, and delivery.

* Support import and export compliance by maintaining accurate shipment records and ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and trade requirements.

* Coordinate customs clearance activities and work closely with customs brokers and government agencies as needed.

* Identify and resolve transportation delays, documentation discrepancies, customs holds, and other shipment-related issues.

* Provide customers with shipment updates, quotes, service options, and solutions to support their logistics needs.

* Maintain accurate data and shipment information within transportation management and operational systems.

* Assist with carrier selection, routing decisions, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

* Support continuous improvement efforts related to service levels, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and successful shipment execution.

* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

**Qualifications**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional logistics, transportation, supply chain, or business coursework preferred.

* Certification/Licensure: No specific certification required; industry certifications related to freight forwarding, import/export, customs, or logistics are a plus.

* Experience: 2+ years of direct experience in freight forwarding required

* Specialized experience in import operations, customs brokerage, and international logistics preferred.

* Experience supporting air freight operations strongly preferred.

* Prior working experience with CargoWise TMS and similar cloud-based transportation management/logistics platforms preferred.

* Working knowledge of international shipping documentation, transportation processes, and import/export procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build relationships across customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve shipment issues efficiently.

* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.

* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)

* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on-site setting (listed in this posting).

new_jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an organized, proactive Project Coordinator to join our Product team. You'll work closely with the Program Manager to keep projects moving, supporting Supply Chain and other cross-functional initiatives such as supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches. You'll be the person who keeps the details in order: agendas drafted, files organized, deliverables tracked, and issues flagged early.

We’re looking for someone who’s energized by the pace and possibility of a fast-growing, mission-driven company. You thrive in a collaborative, nimble environment where ideas are shaped through iteration, feedback, and shared vision. You’re not just a big thinker—you’re also a creative problem-solver who knows how to make things happen with limited resources. The Office of Professional Competence (OPC) is seeking a Program Coordinator to join the team in the San Francisco or Los Angeles office. The annual salary for this role is $83,390 to $111,175. This position has a weekly in office requirement. This role coordinates the daily operations of the State Bar's Minimum Continuing Legal Education (MCLE) compliance desk. The ideal candidate will have strong writing skills, effective customer service experience, and the ability to compile data and make recommendations.

**About the Office**  
The Office of Professional Competence (OPC) helps California attorneys practice law ethically. OPC develops and maintains resources that facilitate compliance with ethical duties. The office administers the MCLE program and a telephone call center called the Ethics Hotline, and conducts preventative education and outreach. The office also supports key committees and working groups that provide ethics guidance and address policy and rule changes, certifies Lawyer Referral Services, and oversees the support side of the Lawyer Assistance Program.

**About the Role**  
Under general direction, the Program Coordinator performs professional administrative coordination supporting the MCLE compliance program. Duties may include:

* Performing professional work that involves the knowledge, interpretation, and application of State Bar policies, rules, regulations, and procedures
* Coordinating daily MCLE compliance desk operations in HubSpot, including monitoring volume and backlog to meet turnaround targets
* Reviewing processes and maintaining program transactions, records, and other documents
* Preparing and maintaining statistical data, reports, correspondence, and special studies, and conducting research
* Providing input in developing and evaluating program policies and procedures, and proposing changes to methods of operation
* Developing and monitoring the annual budget in assigned areas and creating financial and programmatic reports
* Training other staff in program procedures
* Coordinating activities with other State Bar departments and outside agencies, and responding to inquiries from attorneys and the public
Designing, creating, remediating, and placing MCLE content on the State Bar website  

**Program Coordinator Definition**

Under general direction, the Program Coordinator performs professional administrative coordination and development of activities supporting assigned State Bar programs.

**Distinguishing Characteristics**  
The Program Coordinator classification is distinguished from the higher-level Program Analyst in that the Program Coordinator is focused on administrative coordination. In contrast, the Program Analyst is the professional class providing analytical expertise regarding programmatic or functional systems and procedures. It exercises a higher degree of independent judgment and performs more complex work.

**Examples of Essential Duties**  
Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Performs professional work in support of State Bar programs and services involving the knowledge, interpretation, and application of State Bar policies, rules, regulations, and procedures.

* May train other staff in program procedures to ensure the proper level of support for ongoing activities of the department.
* Represents the State Bar at programs and functions, coordinates activities with other State Bar departments and outside agencies, and responds to inquiries from attorneys and the public.
* Coordinates the development of publicity, materials, speakers, registration, and programs for various State Bar events.
* Designs, creates, remediates, and places content materials on the State Bar website.
* Prepares meeting site operations, including a schedule of events and timelines, communicates program requirements, and assists with facility negotiations.
May perform several other similar or related duties that may not be specifically included within this position description but are consistent with the general level of the job.

* Principles of web architecture and development tools.

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility, and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on-street bicycle facilities (1,200+ lane-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility unit seeks to hire a Program Coordinator to support the launch and implementation of the Secure Bike Program (SBP). Over the next five years, NYC DOT will install 500 secure bike parking facilities, creating thousands of safe, convenient bicycle parking spaces across New York City. This initiative will make cycling more accessible and practical by supporting ownership of a wide range of bicycles, including cargo bikes, adaptive bikes, and UL-certified e-bikes. The candidate will also respond to inquiries and support communication efforts related to SBP. Pritchard Industries is a dynamic and innovative provider of comprehensive facility services, dedicated to enhancing the operational efficiency of our client partners in the industries we serve. With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people.

Pritchard Industries is seeking to hire a **Project Manager** to oversee, coordinate, and supervise comprehensive Vendor Management Services for two major NYC institutional facilities totaling over 100,000 sq. ft. each. The Project Manager will serve as the primary on-site and operational point of contact for the New York City Administration for Children's Services (ACS). You will be responsible for overseeing subcontracted vendors, managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, driving preventative maintenance and cost-avoidance strategies, maintaining strict regulatory compliance, and ensuring 24/7/365 continuous operational readiness across both properties.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Vendor & Subcontractor Supervision**

* Supervise, inspect, and coordinate the performance of all subcontracted vendors working on the properties.
* Ensure all vendor work complies with manufacturer recommendations, NYC Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) standards, and applicable NYC/NYS laws.
* Direct competitive procurement for third-party services: solicit and document a minimum of 3 written estimates for purchases over $15,000 and conduct market research for purchases between $5,000 and $15,000.
* Coordinate seamlessly with other city-engaged contractors to prevent work interference or operational friction.

**2. Facilities & MEP Operations**

* Manage off-site and on-demand building engineering services for MEP, elevator, generator, HVAC, lighting, and fire/safety systems during normal business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM).
* Dispatch emergency response staff on-site within **1 hour** for any off-hours system operational failures.
* Conduct an annual Property Analysis and execute an ACS-approved Cost Avoidance & Preventative Maintenance Program.
* Oversee hot/cold water chemical treatments, sanitation, and boiler feed water pH levels in compliance with OSHA MSDS guidelines.
* Implement and manage an Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) program, including annual IAQ reporting, biennial facility inspections, and rapid air testing within 24 hours of suspected issues.

**3. Safety, Emergency Plans & Compliance**

* Review, update, or create Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) and evacuation procedures annually in coordination with ACS and site staff.
* Ensure compliance with all FDNY and NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) regulations, particularly regarding elevator and life safety equipment.
* Support, coordinate and document required emergency drills (e.g., evacuation, shelter-in-place).

**4. Recordkeeping, Logs & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive daily operating logs, physical inventory controls, warranty files, and a dedicated maintenance library.
* Monitor security surveillance system operability (cameras, hardware, software) and report status summaries to ACS at designated intervals.
* Prepare and present reports for oversight entities (e.g., NYS Office of Children and Family Services, NYS Commission of Correction, NYC Council) upon request.
* Implement and maintain ACS-approved Facility Management Software systems.

**5. Labor & Financial Administration**

* Enforce compliance with NYS Labor Law Sections 220 / 231 (Prevailing Wage / Living Wage regulations).
* Ensure all site workers complete 10-hour OSHA construction safety certifications, display laminated photo ID badges, and sign daily sign-in logs.
* Submit detailed monthly expense reports, payroll certifications, and original payroll transcripts to ACS.
* Promptly investigate and submit full written reports on non-compliance notices, accidents, claims, or significant facility incidents within 24 hours.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education:**

* **Minimum Experience:**
* At least 5 years of experience providing vendor/facilities management services for commercial or institutional properties, each measuring no less than 100,000 square feet.
* Strong technical background in commercial MEP systems, elevators, fire alarm/suppression systems, and facility management software.

**Certifications & Compliance Knowledge:**

* Thorough working knowledge of NYC Department of Buildings (DOB), FDNY, OSHA standards, and NYC Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) guidelines.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing NYS Labor Law (Section 220 & 231) prevailing wage compliance, certified payrolls, and reporting.
* OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety Certification (or higher) required.

**Skills & Operational Requirements:**

* **Availability:** Flexible schedule required to manage 24/7/365 coverage and respond on-site to emergency situations within 1 hour.
* **Vendor Procurement:** Demonstrated capability in executing competitive bidding (Best Value framework), invoice auditing, and budget/cost-control management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for interfacing with municipal government clients, labor reps, and oversight agencies.

**Benefits:**

* Full-Time
* Salary: $60.00 - $63.00 per hour

new_jobs.description:
Traba is building a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We started by connecting warehouses, manufacturers, and distributors with reliable workers, and hundreds of operators now run their sites on Traba. Now we're scaling our new AI product, Neo, that helps those operators run their entire operation more efficiently. We're backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

  + Drive pilots to on-time conversion. Build the business case and run the conversion conversation with the economic buyer

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
